When a [ranger] is removed from a Caustic Mulcher, place it on this card. It cannot be moved from here by the Mulcher's effects.
At any point, the group can choose to change their mind and help Kordo instead. If they do, remove all [ranger] from this card and flip it. Replace Accommodation with Intervention on the campaign tracker.
Have all [ranger] on this card: [guide]1.40

B.name: Intervention
B.text:
<f>You've agreed to help Kordo remove the unnatural biomeld Caustic Mulcher from the ecosystem.</f>
<f>Explore the woodlands of the Valley, where Caustic Mulchers can be found.</f>
At any point, the group can choose to change their mind and help Nal instead. If they do, flip this card. Replace Intervention with Accommodation on the campaign tracker.
Clear a Caustic Mulcher with [harm]: [guide]1.41

01419.name: Rising Waters
01419.text: Torrential rains are causing floods. White SkyKobo's MarketGolden Shore Use [guide] 1.05 instead of the normal entries for these locations. When a card with a Flood attached is cleared, place 1[progress] on this mission and shuffle the Flood into the path deck. Have 3[progress] on this mission: [guide] 1.07 [mountain] Add 1 token to the weather.

B.name: Watcher in the Brush
B.text: You have felt a lurking presence following you since your discovery of the strange biomeld corpses. It generally stays out of sight, so you are going to have to confront it to figure out what it wants. Path Deck Assembly: Add the Mysterious Verdessian to the path deck. Clear the Mysterious Verdessian with [progress]

01420.name: Sensor Network
01420.text: Deploy sensors to try to detect reclaimers. The PlummetHigh BasinMound of the Navigator When a feature comes into play at one of these locations, you may attach this mission to it. When a feature with this mission attached is cleared, place 1[progress] on this mission. Have 3[progress] on this mission: [guide] 1.09 [crest] If this mission is attached, exhaust a non-human being. [right_arrow] Unattach this mission unless a ranger spends 1 FOC energy.

B.name: Secret Invasion
B.text: Search for signs of reclaimers to figure out how many are present in the Valley. Path Deck Assembly: At any non-pivotal location, search the General set for 5 Reclaimer Seekers and shuffle them into the Valley set before adding those cards to the path deck. While at a non-pivotal location this mission gains the following test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Search for signs of these strange biomelds to scout a number of path cards equal to twice your effort. Put each Reclaimer card you look at into play. Clear a Reclaimer Seeker: [guide] 1.10

01421.name: Trail of Vines
01421.text: You might be able to track the Mysterious Verdessian through its effects on local flora. When a flora comes into play, place 1 vine token on it. When a card with vine tokens on it is cleared, move those tokens here. Have 2[per_ranger] or more vine tokens on this card: [guide] 1.11 [sun] It must have come this way. Move 1 vine token from a flora to another flora. [mountain] A residual energy causes the plant to grow rapidly. Add 1 vine token to a flora. [crest] Did those plants just... nip at you?! Each Ranger suffers fatigue equal to the number of vine tokens within reach.

B.name: Deeper Motives
B.text:
<f>Help Nal commune with the Verdessian.</f>
<l>Tumbledown</l>
Use [guide] 92 instead of the normal entries for this location and for Spirit Speaker Nal and the Mysterious Verdessian while at this location.
[mountain] If Nal and the Mysterious Verdessian are in play and ready, <f>Nal gets through to it.</f> [right_arrow] [guide] 1.12
[crest] If Nal and the Mysterious Verdessian are in play, <f>the Verdessian tries to flee.</f> [right_arrow] Exhaust Nal unless a ranger suffers 2 fatigue.

01422.name: Find the Nest
01422.text: To study the reclaimers you will first have to track one of them back to their nest. Since you can't keep up with a reclaimer on foot, you will have to tag one with sap and let Gus the mole sniff out the trail for you. [FOC] + [reason]: Affix [2] a tracking sap to a reclaimer to attach this mission card to a Reclaimer Seeker in play. [sun] Discard an active Reclaimer Seeker. If this mission is attached to it, Gus follows the tagged reclaimer. [right_arrow] [guide] 1.15

B.name: Into the Nest
B.text: Travel into the reclaimer nest to study what they are doing in the Valley. Alluvial Ruins Use [guide] 1.16 instead of the normal entries for this location. When a Reclaimer Grub is cleared while at the Alluvial Ruins, place 1[progress] on this mission. Have 3[progress] on this mission: [guide] 1.17

01423.name: Remove the Reclaimers
01423.text:
<f>Search the Valley for options on how to deal with the mounting reclaimer invasion before it overwhelms the Valley.</f>
There are three different options to discover. Talk with people around the Valley who you think might have ideas for how to find them.

B.name: The Valley’s Secrets
B.text:
<f>With the reclaimers gone from the Valley, you can return to helping the inhabitants.</f>
When each of the following entries are written on your campaign tracker: [guide] 1.33
- Met an Interloper
- Spoke With a Spirit
- Found the Perfect Fishing Spot
- Proved Silaro's Hypothesis
- Seen a Person Fly
- Erected a Mighty Statue
- Discovered the Philosopher's Honey
- Carved a Dolewood Canoe
- Celebrated the Harvest Festival
- Faced Your Deepest Fears
- Pruned the Hydraworm
- Witnessed a Masterpiece
- Found Tala a Home

01424.name: Lost Brother
01424.text: Aell fled into the southern swamps. If you can find him, perhaps you can get him to create another flood. Marsh of Rebirth Find a way to travel to the Marsh of Rebirth and locate Aell. Use [guide] 1.19 instead of the normal entries for Aell, Ambitious Shaper.

B.name: Washed away
B.text: Wash away the reclaimers with Aell's flood. When a Reclaimer is discarded by a Flood, do not suffer fatigue. Instead, add 1[progress] to this card. End of the Day: If you haven't completed this mission: [guide] 1.22 Have 2+[per_ranger][progress] on this mission: [guide] 1.23 [mountain] If Aell is active, he summons a torrent of water. [right_arrow] Add 1 flood token to a card of your choice. [crest] If there are no active Reclaimers. [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for the next Reclaimer and put it into play.

01425.name: Worm Food
01425.text: Set up lures around the swamp. The GreenbridgeFrowning Gate When a feature comes into play at one of these locations, you may attach this mission to it. When a feature with this mission attached is cleared, add 1[progress] to this mission. Have 2[progress] on this mission: [guide] 1.24 [crest] If this mission is attached, exhaust a non-human being. [right_arrow] Unattach this mission unless a ranger spends 1 FOC energy.

B.name: Gruesome Feast
B.text: Wait until you're certain enough reclaimers have been lured, and then escape! When there are 2+[per_ranger] Reclaimers in play, attach this mission to the location. [FOC] + [reason]: Lure reclaimers deeper into the swamp to scout path cards equal to twice your effort. Put each Reclaimer card you look at into play. If they have the ambush keyword, treat them as if they do not. End of the Day: If you haven't completed this mission: [guide] 1.28 Travel away while this mission is attached to the location: [guide] 1.27

01426.name: Invasion - Stage I
01426.text: The strange biomelds known as "reclaimers" are swarming over the Valley. More appear each day. Path Deck Assembly: Based on the number of days since you received this mission, check whether your destination has a trait that matches a trait listed below. If it does, search the General set for 3 Reclaimer Seekers and shuffle them into the path deck. 0-2 Days: Ruin 3-4 Days: Ruin, Forest 5-6 Days: Ruin, Forest, Mountain

B.name: Invasion - Stage II
B.text: The reclaimers are everywhere. They seem to be creating nests in certain locations. Path Deck Assembly: If your destination is a Ruin, Forest, or Mountain, search the General set for 1 Reclaimer Polyp and shuffle it into the path deck. Additionally, shuffle in a number of Reclaimer Seekers based on the number of days since you received this mission. 0-2 Days: 1 Reclaimer Seeker 3-4 Days: 2 Reclaimer Seekers 5-6 Days: 3 Reclaimer Seekers

01427.name: Spire Under Attack!
01427.text: A horde of reclaimers is moving towards Spire! You have to get there right away to help with the evacuation. Spire End of the Day: Check off one bubble next to this mission. Arrive at Spire: [guide] 1.29 [crest] Suffer 1 fatigue.

B.name: The Fall of Spire
B.text: The reclaimers are swarming into Spire! Get as many people to safety as possible. End of the Day: If you haven't completed this mission: [guide] 1.31 Use [guide] 93 instead of the normal entries for cards from the Spire set. Save the groups being led by Mora, Dace, and Tollin. Then, travel away from Spire: [guide] 1.30 [mountain] Add 1 mucus token to the location. If there is 3 or more mucus, discard them. [right_arrow] Put a Reclaimer Polyp into play. [crest] Add [harm] to a feature equal to Reclaimers in play. If this clears the feature, a wall collapses. [right_arrow] Each Ranger suffers 3 fatigue.

01428.name: Lure
01428.text: Locate one of the local mega-predators by finding prey to lure it out. When a prey is cleared, set it aside. Arrive at a new location while there is 5 or more total presence of prey set aside: [guide] 1.42 [crest] If there are 2 active predators, exhaust them. [right_arrow] Return 1 set-aside prey to the collection.

B.name: Confront
B.text: You've found the mega-predator! Now it's time to deal with it once and for all. When the subject of this mission is cleared, resolve the following effects instead: Clear [harm]: Permanently kill the majestic mega-predator [guide] 1.44 Clear [progress]: Befriend and calm the beast so it is no longer an issue [guide] 1.43 [sun] If the predator has 2[per_ranger] or more [progress], resolve its [crest] effect. [mountain] If the predator has 3[per_ranger] or more [harm], move it.

01429.name: Search
01429.text: You are following the trail of a missing local. If your current location is not a Ranger Station, when a feature comes into play, place 2 trail tokens on it. When a card with trail tokens on it is cleared, place those tokens on this card. Have 4[per_ranger] or more trail tokens on this mission: [guide] 1.45 [sun] They must have come this way. Move 1 trail token from a feature to another feature. [mountain] The trail grows cold. Remove 1 trail token from a feature. [crest] The urgency of the task weighs on you. Suffer 1 fatigue.

B.name: Rescue
B.text: You've found the missing person! Get them back to safety as quickly as possible. Start of the Day: [guide] 1.47 The subject of this mission gains Persistent. When the subject of this mission is cleared, resolve the following effects instead: Clear [harm]: They worsen and you are forced to stop for the day. [guide] 1.48 Clear [progress]: This being cannot be cleared with [progress]. Ignore this effect. Arrive at a Ranger Station: [guide] 1.46 [sun] If there is no active predator. [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for the next predator and put it into play.

01430.name: Arcology Archaeology
01430.text: Silaro Mako has asked you to keep an eye out for remnants of the old arcology for him. After a ruin is cleared: [guide] 1.49 After this mission has 3 check marks, find Silaro Mako to continue.

B.name: Arcology Archaeology
B.text: Silaro Mako has asked you to keep an eye out for remnants of the old arcology for him. After a ruin is cleared: [guide] 1.49 After this mission has 3 check marks, find Silaro Mako to continue.

02201.name: Lambance Rig
02201.text: Exhaust (use 1 flash): Choose a path card. That card gains illumination until the end of the turn. [FOC] + [reason] (use 1 flash): Distract with a brilliant flash of light to exhaust a being.

02202.name: "Lucky" Cloak
02202.text: Exhaust: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue, draw a challenge card and resolve the following effect based on its icon: [sun] Soothe that amount of fatigue instead. [mountain] Prevent that fatigue. [crest] Suffer 1 additional fatigue or discard this gear.

02203.name: A Frog this Way Comes
02203.text: Choose one: Exhaust X path cards. Shuffle a path card with X or less presence into the path deck. Then search the General set for a Fractal Frog and shuffle it into the path deck.

02204.name: The Shapeshifter
02204.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Shuffle a being attached to this biomeld into the path deck. If that being was a predator, add 3[harm] to another being. If it was a prey, add 4[progress] to another being. Otherwise, exhaust another being. If there is not a being attached to this biomeld, it gains the following test: [AWA] + [connection]: Suggest a new form to attach a non-human being from the path discard facedown to this biomeld. Then exhaust this biomeld.

02205.name: Grasp of the Verdessa
02205.text:
Manifestation. <f>(To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.)</f>
Add 1 [harm] to a flora to place a path card on top of the path deck. If that card is a biomeld, place it on the bottom of the path deck instead.

02206.name: Silaro's Fastidiousness
02206.text: Attach to a Ranger's equipped gear. Response: After a Ranger succeeds at a test from the attached gear, if it cleared a being, scout 1 path card. If it cleared a feature, add 2[progress] to the location. Otherwise, scout 1 Ranger card.

02207.name: Fate of the Reclaimers
02207.text: If you have a weapon equipped, add 3 [harm] to a being. It fatigues you. If it fatigues you for 2 or more, add 2 additional [harm].

02208.name: Rebreather
02208.text: Setup. Exhaust (use 1 filter): When you interact with a water card, commit 2 effort. This gear cannot be discarded or returned to your hand by path card effects.

02209.name: Gus the Mole
02209.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Look at the top card of the path deck. Add [progress] equal to its presence to another path card in play that shares its card type. [FIT] + [connection]: Nuzzle your little friend to ready this being and soothe 1 fatigue.

02210.name: Portable Generator
02210.text: Attach to a feature. Exhaust: The attached feature gains illumination until the end of the turn. Then, if it's a machine, add 1 unique token to it.

02211.name: Wanderer Spirit
02211.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit. [FOC] + [exploration]: Navigate [2] alongside the spirit to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then you may move your [ranger] to a feature in the same area.

02212.name: Expedition Logbook
02212.text: [FOC] + [exploration] (use 1 entry): Consult observations on the arcology to add 1[progress] to a feature for every 2 effort. If that feature is a ruin or machine, add [progress] equal to your effort instead. Then, read [guide] 197.

02213.name: The Ambition of the Estians
02213.text: Move a feature. It fatigues you. Then add [progress] to that feature equal to your fatigue.

02214.name: Ren Kobo's Hat
02214.text: Unique. Exhaust: When you suffer 1 or more fatigue, add an equal number of [progress] to the location. Response: If you have 1 or less fatigue, discard this gear.

02215.name: As Above, So Below
02215.text: Each Ranger can move their [ranger] to a being, feature, or the location.

02216.name: Lunn's Door Opener
02216.text: Setup. Exhaust (use 1 cell): When you interact with a machine, commit 2 effort. [FOC] + [reason] (use 1 cell): Interface with a device to add 1 unique token to a machine for every 2 effort.

02217.name: Stripe, Loyal Lutrinal
02217.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Discard 3[progress] from this being to resolve a challenge effect on a being. [AWA] + [exploration]: Chase [2] the scampering lutrinal to add 1[progress] to a feature for every 2 effort. Then add an equal amount of [progress] to this being and move it.

02218.name: Carried by the Wind
02218.text: Manifestation. Attach to a feature or location. When you Traverse the attached card, dodge all obstacles. If you fail, prevent the injury and return this manifestation to your hand.

02219.name: Archivist Spirit
02219.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit. [SPI] + [reason]: Reflect [2] on the spirit's wisdom to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then scout 1 challenge card.

02220.name: Call the Scuttlebus
02220.text: Response: Before you decide to travel, if there is 2[per_ranger] or more [progress] on the location, you may travel (regardless of the location's [progress] threshold). If there is 5[per_ranger] or more [progress] on it, travel to a location up to two paths away. Use the terrain of the second path when building the path deck.

02221.name: Quisi's Lantern
02221.text: While this card has at least 1 gleam remaining, within reach is illuminated. Exhaust (use 1 gleam): When you perform a test, dodge each card within reach.

02222.name: Echoes of the Estians
02222.text: Attach to a path card. Exhaust: When a Ranger performs a test that interacts with the attached card, commit 2 effort. This test can be performed without commiting energy.

02223.name: Repellent Spores
02223.text: Setup. Exhaust (use 1 puff): When you interact with a flora, commit 2 effort. [FOC] + [reason] (use 1 puff): Release a cloud of spores to exhaust a flora.

02224.name: Bursting with Life
02224.text:
Manifestation.
Choose a flora and either remove 1 [harm] from it or add 2 [progress] to it. Then add 4 [progress] to a non-biomeld being in the same area as the chosen flora.

02225.name: Memlev Hammock
02225.text: Deployed: When you add 1 or more [progress] to a being, increase the [progress] added by 1. When you add 1 or more [progress] to a feature, decrease the [progress] added by 1. This gear gains the following ability: Response: When you rest, soothe 2 fatigue.

02226.name: Mycelial Incense
02226.text: You can Connect with flora features. Exhaust: After you successfully Connect with a flora, soothe 1 fatigue. If that flora has the mycelial keyword, add [progress] equal to your effort to each other flora with the mycelial keyword.

02227.name: Gardener Spirit
02227.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit. [FIT] + [connection]: Tend [2] to the land alongside the spirit to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. You may discard 1[harm] from a feature. If it is a flora, soothe 2 fatigue.

02228.name: The Audacity of the Estians
02228.text: Choose a Ranger to soothe all of their fatigue. Then that Ranger places an equal number of cards from their hand facedown on top of their fatigue stack in any order.

02229.name: Flowsteel Lithophone
02229.text: Exhaust (use 1 tune): After you play a moment or attachment, soothe 1 fatigue. If that card is a tale, gain 1 energy matching that card's aspect.

03001.name: Resourceful
03001.text: After you commit this attribute, search your Ranger deck for the next attribute that you can commit to this test and commit it. If this test is successful, place that attribute on top of your fatigue stack.

03002.name: Grell's Secret Map
03002.text: Unique. Objective (6 hunches: [aspiration]). This gear does not ready during the refresh phase. Exhaust: When a feature with 2 or more presence is cleared, add 1 hunch to this gear and 1[progress] to the location. Response: When you travel, ready this gear.

03003.name: Ironwool Cap
03003.text: Exhaust (use 1 insight): Before you play a moment, reduce its cost by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

03004.name: The Best Teacher
03004.text: Response: After a path card is cleared by [progress], choose a Ranger. That Ranger names a trait. Then they search their Ranger deck and discard for the next moment with the chosen trait and add it to their hand.

03005.name: Friendly Repair Service
03005.text: Objective (6 improvements: [aspiration]). Attach to a human. Response: When a Ranger Connects with the attached human, the Ranger who played this card may discard 1 token from on of their equipped gear to commit 1 effort. Response: After the attached human is cleared with [progress], record 1 improvement and discard this attachment.

03006.name: Kinetic Power Generator
03006.text: Attach to one of your equipped tech. Exhaust: After you succeed at a Traverse test, add 1 token to the attached tech.

03007.name: Alloy Recycler
03007.text: Response: When one of your equipped gear is discarded, you may attach it to this gear, facedown. Exhaust: When a Ranger performs a test, commit a card attached to this gear. (Discard the committed card after the test is resolved.)

03008.name: Featherweight Gauzeweave
03008.text:
Attach to a Ranger's equipped gear.
Reduce the equip value of the attached gear by 2 (to a minimum of 0).

03009.name: Piercing Whistle
03009.text: Search your Ranger deck for a being and add it to your hand. You may discard another being from your hand to play the being you searched for without paying its energy cost.

03010.name: Essays on Shepherding
03010.text: Exhaust (use 1 essay): Move a being. Use 1 essay: When a being would move, it does not. [SPI] + [exploration]: Deepen [2] your understanding to add 1[progress] to a being for every 2 effort. Then add 1 essay to this book.

03011.name: Zoological Recorder
03011.text: Objective (7 records: [aspiration]). Exhaust: Choose a being in the path discard with the same name as a being in play. If no attached beings have that name, attach the being from the path discard to this gear facedown. If you do, add 1 record to this gear and 2[progress] to the being in play.

03012.name: A Deeper Connection
03012.text: Attach to a being within reach. Response: After you successfully Connect with the attached being, soothe 1 fatigue. Response: When [harm] would be added to the attached being, discard this attachment to prevent that [harm].

03013.name: The Full Understory
03013.text: Scout X path cards. X is equal to twice the number of flora in play. If there are no flora in play, search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play.

03014.name: Needle Moss
03014.text: Attach to a flora. Response: When the attached flora clears by [harm], add [harm] to a being in the same area equal to the amount of [harm] on that flora.

03015.name: Mir's Botany
03015.text: [FOC] + [reason] (use 1 lesson): Absorb the botanical knowledge to choose a nature card in your Ranger discard and place it on top of your fatigue stack.

03016.name: The Brilliant Gardener
03016.text: Objective (6 seeds: [aspiration]). [SPI] + [reason]: Plant [5] a brightfruit seed to add 1[progress] to a feature and record 1 seed. Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each flora in play.

03018.name: A Circuitous Route
03018.text: Response: When you would draw a path card, instead discard the top card of the path deck. Then, suffer fatigue equal to that card's presence.

03019.name: Toro the Raccoon
03019.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Discard 1[progress] from an obstacle to move your [ranger] to it. [AWA] + [exploration]: Scavenge [2] for useful scrap to add 1 token to a tech. If you fail, draw a path card.

03020.name: Personal Travelogue
03020.text: Exhaust: When you suffer 1 or more fatigue, add an equal number of stories to this book. [SPI] + [exploration]: Reflect [2] on your travels to discard all stories from this book. If you discarded at least 4 stories, shuffle up to 2 cards from your fatigue stack into your deck.

03021.name: Nut rolled Honey Loaf
03021.text: Use 1 slice: After a being enters play, if it's the start of the round, add 1[progress] to that being. If it enters play during a Ranger's turn, add 2[progress] to that being instead.

03022.name: Gregarious Inventor
03022.text: Exhaust: Choose a Ranger. That Ranger may search their deck for a gear and play it (paying its cost).

03023.name: Creative
03023.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, choose a gear in your Ranger discard and place it on top of your fatigue stack. If your total effort was 3 or more, add it to your hand instead.

03024.name: Carbonforged Theodolite
03024.text: Deployed: When you perform an Avoid test, reduce your effort by 1. When you perform a Traverse test, commit 1 effort. This gear gains the following test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Study the landscape to move a feature and add 1[progress] to it.

03025.name: Power Cell Recycler
03025.text: Exhaust: Discard 2 tokens from one of your equipped tech to add 1 token to any Ranger's equipped tech. Exhaust: Discard a tech from your hand to add 2 tokens to any Ranger's equipped tech.

03026.name: Remote Sentinels
03026.text: Exhaust (use 1 remote): Move a being, treating it as if it does not have ambush. If you moved it within reach, add 1[progress] to it.

03027.name: Pathwarden
03027.text: Exhaust: Either move a being, treating it as if it does not have ambush or discard 1[harm] from a being.

03028.name: Show No Fear
03028.text: Discard a being with 0 presence. If that being is a predator, place it on top of the path deck instead.

03029.name: All Together Now
03029.text: When you perform a test, discard 2 or more [progress] from beings within reach to commit 1 effort for every 2[progress] discarded.

03030.name: Influential
03030.text: If you commited this attribute while interacting with a being, and the test is successful, you may decide which, if any, of that being's challenge effects resolve.

03031.name: Empathy Amplifier
03031.text: Deployed: When you perform a Traverse test, reduce your effort by 1. When you perform a Connect test, commit 1 effort. This gear gains the following ability: Use 1 reading: When a Ranger performs a test that is on a being, commit 2 effort.

03032.name: Anchorite of Stone
03032.text: Exhaust: Add 1 token to a Conduit or ready it.

03033.name: Slow Time
03033.text: Manifestation. Attach to a path card. Use 1 strain: When the attached card would ready, it remains exhausted. Response: When the attached card leaves play, you may discard 1 token from a conduit to attach this manifestation to another path card.

03034.name: All is Clay
03034.text:
Manifestation.
Move any number of beings or features. After moving the last card, each area must have same number of path cards as before you played this manifestation. While moving cards this way, treat them as if they do not have the ambush keyword.

03035.name: Conductor
03035.text: Manifestation. (To commit this attribute, discard 1 token from a conduit.) You can commit this attribute to any test you perform. When you do, suffer 1 fatigue and double the energy committed to this test.

03036.name: Visions of the Floating Tower
03036.text: Use 1 vision: After you discard 1 or more tokens from a conduit, soothe an equal number of fatigue.

03037.name: Keeper of the Grove
03037.text: Exhaust: Before your first turn of the round, add 2[progress] to a spirit. Then, spiritspeak.

03040.name: Clearer of Ways
03040.text: Attach to a spirit. When you play this attachment, you may ready the attached spirit. Response: When a Ranger performs a test, they may discard 2 or more [progress] from the attached spirit. Dodge a card in the same area as it for every 2[progress] discarded.

03041.name: Call Upon the Spirits
03041.text: Search your deck for a spirit and add it to your hand. If you are spiritspeaking, you may play that spirit, reducing its cost by 1. Otherwise, you may exhaust your role to spiritspeak.

03042.name: Sitka Spirit
03042.text: Persistent. Spirit. Response: Before a Sitka Buck would resolve a challenge effect, discard 2[progress] from this spirit to exhaust the Buck.

03043.name: Spirit of the Verdessa
03043.text: Persistent. Unique. Spirit. Exhaust: Discard up to 3[progress] from this spirit to choose a path card in the same area. Reduce that card's presence by the number of [progress] discarded until the end of the turn.

03044.name: The Path Opens Before Me
03044.text: Response: After you succeed at a test that interacts with a spirit, add [progress] to the location equal to your effort. This is in addition to the test's standard effect.

03045.name: Attendant Guide
03045.text: Attach to a spirit. Response: When a Ranger interacts with a card in the same area as the attached spirit, you may exhaust that spirit to commit its approach icons to that test. Exhaust: Move the attached spirit.

03046.name: Atrox Spirit
03046.text: Persistent. Spirit. Response: When Pouncing Atrox enters play, discard 2[progress] from this spirit to treat the Atrox as if it did not have ambush.

03047.name: Spirit of Mount Nim
03047.text: Persistent. Unique. Spirit. Exhaust: When a Ranger interacts with a card in the same area as this spirit, discard 2 or more [progress] from this spirit to commit 1 effort for every 2[progress] discarded.

03048.name: Carbonforged Drum
03048.text: Exhaust (use 1 beat): When a Ranger reveals a challenge card during a test, choose a challenge effect on an active being. Resolve that effect this test.

03049.name: The Long Walk
03049.text: Exhaust (use 1 journey): After you succeed at a test that interacts with a spirit, add [progress] to another spirit equal to your effort. [SPI] + [reason]: Study [2] the wisdom of your ancestors to add 1[progress] for every 2 effort to a spirit. Then add 1 journey to this book.

03050.name: Irix Spirit
03050.text: Persistent. Spirit. Response: When you travel, discard 2[progress] from this spirit to treat all Circling Irix as if they did not have persistent.

03052.name: That Which Connects Us
03052.text: Attach to a being with 1 or less presence. The attached being gains friendly. Exhaust: Move up to 2[progress] from the attached being to another being in the same area.

03053.name: Heart Harmonizer
03053.text: Exhaust (use 1 song): After you succeed at a Connect or Commune test, soothe 1 fatigue. Response: When you would suffer an injury, spend 2[progress] from a spirit within reach to prevent it.

03054.name: Lutrinal Spirit
03054.text: Persistent. Spirit. Response: Before a Romping Lutrinal would move, discard 1[progress] from this spirit to prevent it.

03055.name: Spirit of the Silverfin
03055.text: Persistent. Unique. Spirit. Exhaust: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue or an injury while this spirit is within reach, discard 3[progress] from it to prevent that fatigue or injury.

03056.name: The Cats of Elder Atma
03056.text: Response: When a Ranger performs a test, they dodge 1 card. If that Ranger has 5 or more fatigue, add this moment back to your hand instead of discarding it.

03057.name: Hush Little Critter
03057.text: Attach to a being. Use 1 hum: When the attached being would ready, it remains exhausted. If its presence is 2 or more, the Ranger who played this attachment suffers 1 fatigue. Response: When the attached being readies, discard this attachment.

03058.name: The Better Part of Valor
03058.text: Choose a being within reach of a Ranger. That being fatigues that Ranger. Shuffle that being into the path deck. That Ranger scouts a number of path cards equal to the chosen being's presence, then draws a path card.

03059.name: Wonders of the Valley
03059.text: Attach to a location or feature. When you play this attachment on a feature, you may move that feature. Exhaust: After a Ranger suffers 1 or more fatigue, add [progress] to the attached card equal to the number of fatigue suffered plus 1.

03060.name: The Buck and the Wolhund
03060.text: Add 1[harm] to a prey to exhaust and add 3[harm] to a predator.

03061.name: Go Forth, Fearless Ranger
03061.text:
Aspiration (9 feats: [aspiration]).
Choose a Ranger to perform a test, doubling its difficulty. If they succeed, they soothe 2 fatigue. Then record feats equal to the test's original difficulty.

03062.name: The Tale of Two Rivers
03062.text: Response: When a Ranger resolves an effect that scouts and/or draws cards from their deck, they do so from their fatigue stack instead. Then, if that Ranger has 5 or more fatigue, return this moment to your hand.

03063.name: Book of Great Deeds
03063.text: Response: After a Ranger succeeds at a test with 4 or more effort or suffers 2 or more fatigue, add 1 deed to this gear. [SPI] + [exploration] (use 1 deed): Recount [2] your adventures to shuffle a card from the top of a Ranger's fatigue stack into their deck. Add 2[progress] to each human within reach of them.

03064.name: Transverse Ocarina
03064.text: Exhaust (use 1 melody): Ready an attachment or a card with a tale attached to it. Exhaust (use X melodies): After you play an attachment on a path card, exhaust that path card. X is equal to that card's presence.

03065.name: The Tireless Artisan
03065.text: Response: When a Ranger rests, they soothe 2 fatigue. If that Ranger has 5 or more fatigue, they soothe 4 fatigue instead.

03066.name: Songweave Mantle
03066.text: You may play this gear equipped to another Ranger. Exhaust (use 1 buffer): When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue, discard a card from your hand. If you do, either prevent 1 of that fatigue or, if you have 5 or more fatigue, prevent all of it.

03067.name: The Stouthearted Guardian
03067.text: Attach to a Ranger's role. Response: After you exhaust your role, you may soothe 1 fatigue. Response: When you would discard your fatigue stack due to an injury, discard this tale instead.

03068.name: Dolewood Lute
03068.text: Exhaust (use 1 strum): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes 1 fatigue. If there is a tale attached to their role they soothe 1 additional fatigue.

03069.name: Dauntless
03069.text: After a test in which you committed this attribute, if your effort was 1 or less, you may place this attribute on top of your fatigue stack.

03070.name: Observant
03070.text: Before you commit this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue. If you do, this attribute gains [conflict] [reason].

03071.name: Enthusiastic
03071.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, if your effort was 3 or more, move 1 being.

03072.name: Steadfast
03072.text: Before you commit this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue. If you do, this attribute gains [exploration] [connection].

03073.name: Deliberate
03073.text: While you have 6 or more other cards in your hand, this attribute gains [reason] [exploration].

03074.name: Ingenious
03074.text: Before you commit this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue. If you do, this attribute gains [reason] [exploration].

03075.name: Sensible
03075.text: After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may place a card from your hand on top of your fatigue stack to add this attribute back to your hand.

03076.name: Magnanimous
03076.text: Before you commit this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue. If you do, this attribute gains [connection] [conflict].

03201.name: Gratitude of the Valley
03201.text: Personal Reward (Friendly Repair Service). Response: After you arrive at a location, each Ranger may choose one: Add 2 tokens to one of their equipped gear. Equip a gear from their hand without paying its energy cost.

03202.name: Superior Trail
03202.text: Personal Reward (Grell's Secret Map). Clear [progress]: For each feature in play, choose one (you may choose the same option more than once): Exhaust and move that feature. Add 3[progress] to that feature. Soothe fatigue equal to that feature's presence.

03203.name: Zoological Compendium
03203.text: Personal Reward (Zoological Recorder). Exhaust: Attach a non-human being from the path discard to this gear, facedown. [SPI] + [reason]: Apply the knowledge within to shuffle an attached card into the path deck to choose a being with which it shares a trait. Add 3[progress] to that being and exhaust it.

03204.name: Brightfruit Tree
03204.text: Personal Reward (The Brilliant Gardener). Illumination. [AWA] + [reason]: Harvest [2] the luminous fruit to add 2[harm] to this flora, soothe 1 fatigue, and shuffle the top card of your fatigue stack into your Ranger deck. Response: After a Ranger adds 1 or more [harm] to this flora, they gain 1 energy of any type.

03205.name: The Bravest Ranger
03205.text: Personal Reward (Go Forth, Fearless Ranger). Attach to a Ranger's role without The Bravest Ranger attached. Exhaust: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue, you may instead place that many cards from your hand on top of your fatigue stack.

03219.name: Grell's Secret Map
03219.text: Record 6 hunches to complete this aspiration.

B.name: Grell's Secret Map
B.text: Unique. Objective (6 hunches: [aspiration]). This gear does not ready during the refresh phase. Exhaust: When a feature with 2 or more presence is cleared, add 1 hunch to this gear and 1[progress] to the location. Response: When you travel, ready this gear.

03220.name: Grell's Secret Map
03220.text: You gain the Superior Trail reward card. (Only you may swap this card into your deck when you camp.)

B.name: Grell's Secret Map
B.text: Unique. Objective (6 hunches: [aspiration]). This gear does not ready during the refresh phase. Exhaust: When a feature with 2 or more presence is cleared, add 1 hunch to this gear and 1[progress] to the location. Response: When you travel, ready this gear.

03221.name: Friendly Repair Service
03221.text: Record 6 improvements to complete this aspiration.

B.name: Friendly Repair Service
B.text: Objective (6 improvements: [aspiration]). Attach to a human. Response: When a Ranger Connects with the attached human, the Ranger who played this card may discard 1 token from on of their equipped gear to commit 1 effort. Response: After the attached human is cleared with [progress], record 1 improvement and discard this attachment.

03222.name: Friendly Repair Service
03222.text: You gain the Gratitude of the Valley reward card. (Only you may swap this card into your deck when you camp.)

B.name: Friendly Repair Service
B.text: Objective (6 improvements: [aspiration]). Attach to a human. Response: When a Ranger Connects with the attached human, the Ranger who played this card may discard 1 token from on of their equipped gear to commit 1 effort. Response: After the attached human is cleared with [progress], record 1 improvement and discard this attachment.

03223.name: Zoological Recorder
03223.text: Record 7 entries to complete this aspiration.

B.name: Zoological Recorder
B.text: Objective (7 records: [aspiration]). Exhaust: Choose a being in the path discard with the same name as a being in play. If no attached beings have that name, attach the being from the path discard to this gear facedown. If you do, add 1 record to this gear and 2[progress] to the being in play.

03224.name: Zoological Recorder
03224.text: You gain the Zoological Compendium reward card. (Only you may swap this card into your deck when you camp.)

B.name: Zoological Recorder
B.text: Objective (7 records: [aspiration]). Exhaust: Choose a being in the path discard with the same name as a being in play. If no attached beings have that name, attach the being from the path discard to this gear facedown. If you do, add 1 record to this gear and 2[progress] to the being in play.

03225.name: The Brilliant Gardener
03225.text: Record 6 seeds to complete this aspiration.

B.name: The Brilliant Gardener
B.text: Objective (6 seeds: [aspiration]). [SPI] + [reason]: Plant [5] a brightfruit seed to add 1[progress] to a feature and record 1 seed. Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each flora in play.

03226.name: The Brilliant Gardener
03226.text: You gain the Brightfruit Tree reward card. (Only you may swap this card into your deck when you camp.)

B.name: The Brilliant Gardener
B.text: Objective (6 seeds: [aspiration]). [SPI] + [reason]: Plant [5] a brightfruit seed to add 1[progress] to a feature and record 1 seed. Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each flora in play.

03227.name: Go Forth, Fearless Ranger
03227.text: Record 9 feats to complete this aspiration. Optionally, you can describe each feat on a scrap piece of paper so that you may recall details later.

B.name: Go Forth, Fearless Ranger
B.text:
Aspiration (9 feats: [aspiration]).
Choose a Ranger to perform a test, doubling its difficulty. If they succeed, they soothe 2 fatigue. Then record feats equal to the test's original difficulty.

03228.name: Go Forth, Fearless Ranger
03228.text: You gain The Bravest Ranger reward card. (Only you may swap this card into your deck when you camp.)

B.name: Go Forth, Fearless Ranger
B.text:
Aspiration (9 feats: [aspiration]).
Choose a Ranger to perform a test, doubling its difficulty. If they succeed, they soothe 2 fatigue. Then record feats equal to the test's original difficulty.

03248.name: A Preserved Day
03248.text: Refresh: Add 1 crack to this card. If there are 3 or more cracks, flip this card. [mountain]Add 1[progress] to the location.

B.name: Fractured Sky
B.text: FOC + [reason]: Repair rents in the forged reality to discard 1 crack for every 2 effort. if there are no cracks remaining, flip this card. [sun]Move 1[progress] from the location to each card within reach. Discard 1 crack. If there are no remaining cracks, flip this card.

03249.name: Enveloping Silence
03249.text: [sun]Each Ranger may discard 1 energy <f>to stay quiet</f>. If a Ranger does not, add echoes equal to your effort (min. 1) and flip this card.

B.name: Reverberating Echo
B.text: FOC + [reason]: Wait out the ringing sound to discard echoes equal to your effort. Then, if there are no remaining echoes, flip this card. [sun]Each ranger suffers 1 fatigue. Discard one echo. If there are no remaining echoes, flip this card. [mountain] Ready a predator or prey. discard one echo. If there are no remaing echoes, flip this card.

03250.name: Glitterain
03250.text:
[sun]Add 1 runoff to this card. [then] Each ranger suffers 1 fatigue. If there is 5 or more runoff, flip this card.
[mountain] For the remainder of this test, all areas count as illuminated.

B.name: Shimmering Runoff
B.text:
Along the way is illuminated.
[sun]Move 1 feature or being, discard runoff equal to its presence (minimum 1). If there is no remaining runoff, flip this card.

03251.name: The Chimney
03251.text:
Response: When you interact with this location, dodge all illuminated cards.
 If the Chimney is Settled, it gains: AWA + [exploration]: Search the many levels to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card.

B.name: The Chimney
B.text: [guide] 100 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: If you traveled to this location from Spire, search the path deck for The Spiral Stairway and put it into play. Otherwise, search the path deck for The Plint and put it into play. Then read the journal entry for that card.

03252.name: Severed Artery
03252.text: [sun] If within reach is not illuminated, you lose track of your surroundings. [then] Discard 1 [progress] from an active feature.

B.name: Severed Artery
B.text: [guide] 101 Path Deck Assembly Randomly choose and shuffle only 2 cards from the Artery set into the path deck. Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03252.pda: Randomly choose and shuffle only 2 cards from the Artery set into the path deck.

03253.name: Branching Artery
03253.text: [sun] If along the way is not illuminated, you lose your way [then] Discard 2 [progress] from the location. If you cannot, suffer 1 fatigue.

B.name: Branching Artery
B.text: [guide]102 Arrival Setup Lead ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: draw a path card.

03254.name: Terminal Artery
03254.text: Refresh: Randomly choose and shuffle 1 of the set aside cards from the Artery set into the path deck.

B.name: Terminal Artery
B.text: [guide]103 Path Deck Assembly Randomly choose and shuffle only 1 card from the Artery set into the path deck. Set the others aside. Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Dra a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03254.pda: Randomly choose and shuffle only 1 card from the Artery set into the path deck.

03255.name: Mycelial Conclave
03255.text: [sun] Remove 1[harm] or 1[progress] from an active flora.

B.name: Mycelial Conclave
B.text: [guide]104 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play. Next Ranger: draw a path card.

03256.name: Arboretum of Memory
03256.text: SPI + [reason]: Reflect [2] on your memories and experiences to return a card from our and to your collection. Choose a starting moment or attachment from your collection that you meet the aspect requirement for and add it to your hand. (This alteration to your deck is permanent.)

B.name: Arboretum of Memory
B.text: [guide] 105 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

B.name: The Verdant Sphere
B.text: [guide]106 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next machine and put it into play.

03258.name: The Cage
03258.text: AWA + [exploration]: Explore [2] the chamber to scout path cards equal to your effort, then dra a path card.

B.name: The Cage
B.text: [guide]107 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Search the General set for The Heart and put it into play, Expanded side faceup. Then, draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03259.name: Drenching Chamber
03259.text: Response: When a ranger performs a Traverse test on this location, they may spend 1 energy of any type and trudge through the waist-deep water to commit 1 effort.

B.name: Drenching Chamber
B.text: [guide]108 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play.

03260.name: Oasis of Sunlight
03260.text: All areas are illuminated unless a Ranger has fewer than 10 cards remaining in their Ranger deck.

B.name: Oasis of Sunlight
B.text: [guide] 109 Path Deck Assembly Randomly shuffle 3 cards from the Woods set into the path deck. Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03260.pda: Randomly shuffle 3 cards from the Woods set into the path deck.

03261.name: Desert of Endless Night
03261.text: Refresh: Flip one path card that is not illuminated facedown. It keeps any attachments. Treat facedown cards as features with a presence of 2. If a facedown card is illuminated, flip it faceup.

B.name: Desert of Endless Night
B.text: [guide]110 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card, it comes into play facedown along the way. Next Ranger: Draw a path card, it comes into play facedown along the way.

03262.name: Cerulean Curtain
03262.text: [mountain] The pounding waterfall drenches everything around you. Exhaust a card within reach, then either exhaust your role or suffer 1 fatigue.

B.name: Cerulean Curtain
B.text: [guide]111 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card.

03263.name: Orlin's Vault
03263.text: FOC + [exploration]: Tinker [2] with the ancient Estian equipment to add 1 unique token to an equipped tech for every 2 effort.

B.name: Orlin's Vault
B.text: [guide]112 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card.

03264.name: Scuttler Network
03264.text: [mountain] If within reach is not illuminated and there is no active Juvenile Spindlescuttler, something scuttles toward you. [then] Search the Cave System set for a Juvenile Spindlescuttler.

B.name: Scuttler Network
B.text: [guide]113 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next predator and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play.

03265.name: The Cistern
03265.text: SPI + [exploration]: Drink [2] of the effervescent waters to soothe 1 fatigue for every 2 effort.

B.name: The Cistern
B.text: [guide]114 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03266.name: Silent Dormitories
03266.text: [sun] The spirits of this place stir. Either remove 2[progress] from a feature to soothe 1 fatigue, or suffer 1 fatigue to place 2 [progress] on a feature.

B.name: Silent Dormitories
B.text: [guide]115 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03267.name: Carbonforged Maze
03267.text: Response: When you Traverse this location, reduce the amount of [progress] added by 1 unless your [ranger] is on this location. AWA + [conflict]: Squeeze [2] through the narrow tunnels to move your [ranger] to this location.

B.name: Carbonforged Maze
B.text: [guide]116 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03268.name: Inverted Forest
03268.text: Response: When you perform a common test, if your [ranger] is on this location, commit 1 effort. FIT + [reason]: Climb [2] to the footbridge to move your [ranger] to this location and scout 1 path card for every 2 effort. If you fail suffer 1 injury.

B.name: Inverted Forest
B.text: [guide]117 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03269.name: The Rootway
03269.text: Refresh: If there is no active flora, search the path deck and discard pile for the next flora and put it into play.

B.name: The Rootway
B.text: [guide]118 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play.

03270.name: Talpid's Squeeze
03270.text: While there is 1 or more debris on this location, you cannot travel. FOC + [conflict]: Disassemble [2] the pile of collapsed rubble to discard 1 debris from this location for every 2 effort. [mountain] If there is at leas 1 debris on this location, the debris shifts. [then] Discard all [progress] from an active feature. If at least 2 progress was discarded, discard 1 debris.

B.name: Talpid's Squeeze
B.text: [guide]119 Arrival Setup Lead Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card. Next Ranger: Draw a path card.

03271.name: Bustling Lightbringer
03271.text: Powered [1]: This machine gains Illumination. Powered [1]: If there is an active feature, discard 1 power from this being.  Add 1 to that feature. Then move this being. Powered [1]: If there is an active predator, exhaust it.  Add  to this being equal to that predator's presence.

03272.name: Capacitive Leech
03272.text: Discard 1 unique token from a machine or tech.  Add 1 power to this being. If there is an active predator, exhaust it.  Add 2 to it and  to this being equal to that predator's presence. Powered [3]: Discard 3 power from this parasite.  Suffer 1 injury.

03273.name: Coruscating Phantom
03273.text: Ambush. Illumination. If one area has more total power than any other, the phantom hungers.  Move this predator to that area. If you have an equipped tech, exhaust this predator.  Suffer 1 injury.

03274.name: Humming Circuits
03274.text: Powered [1]: This machine gains Illumination. FOC + : Redirect the current to discard power up to your effort from this feature to add an equal amount of unique tokens to a machine or tech. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. Powered [1]: Add 1 power to the machine with the least power.

03275.name: Overgrown Vestiges
03275.text: Obstacle. If this feature is illuminated, it loses Obstacle and gains the following test: AWA + : Discover something useful in the overgrowth to search your Ranger deck for a gear and add it to your hand. If this feature is illuminated, the way becomes clear.  Add 1 to it.

03276.name: Kinetic Transfer Pods
03276.text: SPI + : Brave [X] the ancient transportation system to move your  to or remove it from this feature. X is equal to 3 minus the amount of power on this feature (minimum 0). Response: When you travel, if all  are on this feature and there is more power than , you may travel to a location up to two paths away. Use the terrain of the second path when building the path deck. If this ruin has more  than power, the pod falls!  Each Ranger whose  is here suffers 1 injury. Discard this ruin.

03277.name: Veiled Axolotak
03277.text: Ambush. If this predator is illuminated, it loses Ambush. If there is a water feature in another area, the tyrant lurks in the depths.  Move this being to that area. If you have 2 or more fatigue, exhaust this being.  Suffer 1 injury.

03278.name: Scavenging Sawtooth
03278.text: If there is an active ruin or machine, the steelgnawer chews on it.  Add 2 to it and 2 to this being. If there is an active predator, exhaust it.  Add  to it and  to this being equal to its presence. If this being is not illuminated, exhaust it.  Discard 2 unique tokens from one of your equipped gear.

03279.name: Incendiary Lilies
03279.text: AWA + : Harvest [2] the medicinal seeds, careful not to gather too many to add 1 to this feature and either heal 1 injury from a Ranger, or discard 2 from a being. Clear : Each Ranger suffers 1 injury. Add 1 to an active water feature.

03280.name: Sparking Circuits
03280.text: Powered [1]: This machine gains Illumination. X is equal to the amount of power on this machine. FOC + : Redirect the dangerous current to discard power up to your effort from this feature to add an equal amount of unique tokens to a machine or tech. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. Powered [1]: Add 1 power to the machine with the least power. Powered [2]: Discard 1 power from this feature.  Add 1 to each card in the same area as it. Then it fatigues you.

03281.name: Flooded Chamber
03281.text: Each predator and prey with no  gains Persistent. FIT + : Swim [2] into the chamber to return all of your equipped gear to your hand and move your  to this feature. Clear : Draw two path cards. If there is an active predator or prey, it leaps from the water.  Resolve the  effect on it. Each Ranger whose  is on this feature suffers 1 fatigue.

03282.name: Heaped Detritus
03282.text: Illumination. Obstacle. Clear : Shuffle a Scavenging Sawtooth into the path deck for each power on this feature. Exhaust this feature.  Search the path deck and discard for a Scavenging Sawtooth and put it into play.

03283.name: Spindlescuttler Matron
03283.text: Disconnected. If this predator is illuminated, it loses Discon-nected. Clear : Search the path deck and discard for the next Juvenile Spindlescuttler and place it on the top of the path deck. Add 3 to the active feature with theh highest presence. If that feature is a flora, add 2 to this being. If this being is illuminated or if you have 2 or more fatigue, exhaust this being.  Suffer 1 injury.

03284.name: Juvenile Spindlescuttler
03284.text: Disconnected. If this predator is illuminated, it loses Discon-nected. Add 2 to the active feature with the highest presence. If that feature is a flora, add 2 to this being. If this being is illuminated or if you have 3 or more fatigue, exhaust this being.  Suffer 1 injury.

03285.name: Timid Talpid
03285.text: Clear : Scout 1 path card. If this being is illuminated, it burrows away.  Draw 1 path card, then shuffle this being into the path deck. If there is an active predator, exhaust it.  Add  to it and  to this being, both equal to that predator's presence.

03286.name: Prismatic Mushrooms
03286.text: Illumination. Mycelial. AWA + : Discover another glowing patch of mushrooms to add 1 to this feature and move it to another area. The soft light is a relief from the encroaching darkness. You may exhaust a Ranger card to soothe 1 fatigue. If there is an active prey, exhaust it.  Add  to it and  to this feature, both equal to that prey's presence.

03287.name: Vengeful Stalactites
03287.text: Obstacle. If this feature is illuminated, it loses Obstacle. Clear : Each Ranger with less AWA energy than this feature's presence suffers 1 injury. Add 1 to this feature.

03288.name: Spindlescuttler Warren
03288.text: Persistent. Each being in play that is not illuminated gains Persistent. FOC + : Navigate [2] the twisting passage to move your  to this feature. Clear : You find another route through the caverns. You may remove all  from this feature to discard an equal number of beings. If you do, do not discard this feature.

03289.name: Slithering Vines
03289.text: All Snapping Maws gain Persistent. If this feature is illuminated, it turns toward the light.  Ready a flora. If there is a Snapping Maw that is not within reach, one draws closer.  Move a Snapping Maw to within reach.

03290.name: Ghost-eyed Lepolors
03290.text: Illumination. Move this prey. If there is an active predator, exhaust it.  Add  to it and  to this being, both equalto that predator's presence.

03291.name: Snapping Maw
03291.text: If this predator is illuminated, it unfurls its toothy petals.  Discard 1 from it. If you have 1 or more fatigue, exhaust this being.  Suffer 1 injury.

03292.name: Venerable Lightbringer
03292.text: Powered [1]: This machine gains Illumination. Powered [1]: If there is an active feature, discard 1 power from this being.  Add 1 to that feature. Then move this being. If there is an active prey, exhaust it.  Add  to it and  to this feature, both equal to that prey's presence.

03293.name: Ivory Flowers

If this feature is illuminated, the light reveals the tunnel ahead.  Scout 1 path card.

03315.name: Progenitor Mushroom

[sun] You may discard 3[progress] from this spirit and exhaust it to choose a nature card in your discard and add it to your hand.

03323.name: The Grovetender

[FOC] + [reason]: Interpret [3] the stream of information to read [guide] 136.2 and add 2[progress] to the attached flora. [FIT] + [conflict]: Carry the grovetender to attach this machine to another flora. Ready that flora.

03351.text: Attach to The Heart. [AWA] + [exploration]: Discover [2] the root of the heart's fear to attach this emotion to a different organ. [crest] If you have 3 or more fatigue, exhaust this card. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury and discard 1 spore from the attached Spore Cloud.

03354.text: [FIT] + [reason]: Climb [2] to the top to move your [ranger] to this structure. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. If there is more than 2[per_ranger] power on this structure and your [ranger] is on it, discard 1[per_ranger] power. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

03355.text: This feature cannot leave play except when you travel or it is discarded by the campaign guide. Response: After this feature flips. exhaust it. Then resolve and discard each attached challenge card. Then ready this feature. Clear [harm]: [guide] 140 [sun] Draw and attach 1 challenge card to this organ. If there are 3 or more, it expands. 03357.name: The Descent
03357.text: You must journey into the dark to lend aid to Silaro's expedition. You can either descend to the Chimney from the Arcology Threshold in Spire, or find an Arcology Sinkhole, and descend from there. Once at the Chimney, you'll need to find and talk to Silaro. Arrive at the Chimney: [guide] 1.101

B.name: An Urgent Request
B.text: Silaro has requested that you meet him at the Concordant Ziggurats. You can either head to the surface via the Spiral Stairway in the Chimney or find an Elevated Passage to ascend to the surface. Arrive at the Concordant Ziggurats: [guide] 1.107

03358.name: The Long Dark
03358.text: You must venture into the deepest section of the arcology. Perhaps there you can find a way to stop the earthquakes that threaten to destroy the arcology and the Valley above. Arrive at the Cage: [guide] 1.117

B.name: The Final Ascent
B.text: It is time to return to the Chimney, gather up the expedition, and return to the surface. Arrive at the Chimney: [guide] 1.132

03359.name: Following a Lead
03359.text:
<f>You have found an important clue leading you to another location.</f>
Do not add this mission to the campaign tracker. If you do not follow this lead before the end of the day, the opportunity is lost for now.
The attached feature gains Persistent.

B.name: Following a Lead
B.text:
<f>You have found an important clue leading you to another location.</f>
Do not add this mission to the campaign tracker. If you do not follow this lead before the end of the day, the opportunity is lost for now.
The attached feature gains Persistent.

03360.name: Limited Time Offer
03360.text: Word is going around that Ren Kobo is holding a massive swap meet at his market west of Spire. Get there quickly before the swap meet ends! Arrive at Kobo's Market: [guide] 1.103 [mountain] Another villager on the way to the swap meet shares the trail with you for a moment. Add 1[progress] to the location.

B.name: Kobo's Swap Meet
B.text: Each human gains the following test: [SPI] + [conflict]: Barter with the locals to move 1 card from your hand to your displaced cards and add 1 card on offer for which you meet the requirements to your hand. Then flip a new card from the swappables deck. Note: Record any gained rewards on your campaign tracker, placing a checkmark next to it for each copy gained. You have unlocked that many copies of that reward card. If you travel away, if the day ends, or if you claim or discard the last swappable: [guide] 1.104 [sun] If there is no active predator, trade continues. [right_arrow] Discard 1 random card on offer. Then flip a new card from the swappables deck. [mountain] Discard 1 random card on offer for each active human. Then flip an equal number of new cards from the swappables deck.

03361.name: Search Below
03361.text: You are searching for someone underground. When a feature comes into play, if your current location is in the Arcology and is not the Chimney, add 2 trail tokens to it. When a card with trail tokens on it is cleared, move those tokens to this mission. Have 4[per_ranger] or more trail tokens on this mission: [guide] 1.102 [sun] They must have come this way. Move 1 trail token from a feature to another feature. [mountain] The trail grows cold. Discard 1 trail token from a feature. [crest] Something lurks in the dark ahead. Scout 1 path card. If it is a being, put it into play.

B.name: Return to Base Camp
B.text: You must accompany your friend back to the base camp at the Chimney. Start of Day: [guide] 1.102d The attached being gains Persistent. When the attached being's [harm] or [progress] threshold is met, resolve the following effects instead: Clear [harm]: [guide] 1.102c Clear [progress]: Discard all [progress] from this being. They remain in play. Do not read their entry. Arrive at the Chimney: [guide] 1.102b [sun] If there is no active predator, one draws near. [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for the next predator and put it into play.

03362.name: Survey the Depths
03362.text: Silaro has asked you to explore locations neighboring the Chimney. Drenching ChamberOrlin's VaultScuttler Network When a feature comes into play at one of these locations, you may attach this mission to it. When a feature with this mission attached is cleared, add 1 survey to this mission. If you travel, discard all surveys from this mission. Have 3 surveys on this mission: [guide] 1.106 [mountain] If this mission is attached to a feature that is not illuminated, the darkness presses in. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 fatigue.

B.name: Power Up
B.text: Help Silaro reroute power to the ziggurats and invigorate the arcology. Use [guide] 1.108 instead of the normal entry for The Concordant Ziggurats. When an Unstable Ziggurat is cleared, move all power from it to the location. Have 4[per_ranger] or more power on the Concordant Ziggurats: [guide] 1.109 [sun] Silaro points you in the right direction. Shuffle an Unstable Ziggurat from the path discard into the path deck. [mountain] Strange energies pour forth. Move 1 power from the location to an Unstable Ziggurat.

03363.name: Collapse!
03363.text: Whatever Silaro did at the Concordant Ziggurats caused the very ground to shake, potentially causing sections of the arcology to collapse. Kal Iver, Harlan, and Quisi Vos were exploring the arcology when it happened. You need to find them and ensure their safety. Path Deck Assembly: At each Valley location, search the Valley set for an Arcology Sinkhole and add it to the path deck. Arrive at the location marked UNEXPLORED on your campaign tracker: [guide] 1.110 [crest] You are overcome with worry. Either discard 1 FOC energy or suffer 1 fatigue.

B.name: Buried Survey Team
B.text: Your friends have been buried alive! Kal IverQuisi VosHarlan Vos Use [guide] 1.110 instead of the normal entry for the location marked UNEXPLORED on the campaign tracker and for cards from the rescue deck. [FIT] + [conflict]: Dig for your friends to scout cards from the rescue deck equal to your effort, then draw 1 card from it. If any of the scouted cards are Shifting Rubble, they must be placed on top. Have all 3 bubbles checked off: [guide] 1.111 [mountain] An aftershock shakes the chamber. Shuffle the rescue deck unless you discard 1 AWA energy.

03364.name: Breathe Easier
03364.text: You are attempting to power up an old Estian rebreather gifted to you by Lunn. You must search through any rubble you come across to find a functional "quantum cube," then plug it into the device. Path Deck Assembly: If the location is in the arcology, search the General set for 4 Shifting Rubble and shuffle them into the path deck. Response: After you clear a Shifting Rubble, draw a challenge card and resolve the effect corresponding to its challenge icon: [sun] Add 2 quantum cubes to this mission. [mountain] Add 1 quantum cube to this mission, then draw 1 path card. [crest] Ready all beings. Have 2+[per_ranger] or more quantum cubes on this mission: [guide] 1.112

B.name: Breathe Easier
B.text: You are attempting to power up an old Estian rebreather gifted to you by Lunn. You must search through any rubble you come across to find a functional "quantum cube," then plug it into the device. Path Deck Assembly: If the location is in the arcology, search the General set for 4 Shifting Rubble and shuffle them into the path deck. Response: After you clear a Shifting Rubble, draw a challenge card and resolve the effect corresponding to its challenge icon: [sun] Add 2 quantum cubes to this mission. [mountain] Add 1 quantum cube to this mission, then draw 1 path card. [crest] Ready all beings. Have 2+[per_ranger] or more quantum cubes on this mission: [guide] 1.112

03365.name: Spore Specimens
03365.text: Collect spores from the underground mushrooms to test on other flora and fauna. Response: When you travel, if you are not traveling on Fungal Forest terrain, flip this card. When a feature with the mycelial keyword comes into play, add 1 spore to it. Cards with spores gain the following test: [FOC] + [conflict]: Collect the spores to move spores up to your effort from this flora to the Spore Specimens mission. [sun] If a card has more than 1 spore, they spread. [right_arrow] Distribute those spores to other active path cards as evenly as possible. [mountain] The spore clouds expand. Add 1 spore to each active path card with a spore.

B.name: Spore Specimens
B.text: Collect spores from the underground mushrooms to test on other flora and fauna. Response: When you travel, if you are not traveling on Fungal Forest terrain, flip this card. When a feature with the mycelial keyword comes into play, add 1 spore to it. Cards with spores gain the following test: [FOC] + [conflict]: Collect the spores to move spores up to your effort from this flora to the Spore Specimens mission. [sun] If a card has more than 1 spore, they spread. [right_arrow] Distribute those spores to other active path cards as evenly as possible. [mountain] The spore clouds expand. Add 1 spore to each active path card with a spore.

03366.name: Artificial Adaptation
03366.text: You are searching for power cell adapters used in Estian machinery. When a machine comes into play, add adapters to it equal to its presence. Each card with an adapter gains the following test: [FOC] + [reason]: Extract the Estian tech without triggering the arcology's defenses to move adapters from this card to Artificial Adaptation equal to your effort. If your effort is 2 or more, search the General set for a Crimson Guardian and put it into play. Have 1+[per_ranger] or more adapters on this mission: [guide] 1.115 [mountain] If an active machine has both power and adapter tokens, the adapter arcs with energy. [right_arrow] Discard 1 of each from it.

B.name: Assembly Required
B.text: Use the power cell adapters you found to repair Lunn's "artisanal" door opener. Orlin's Vault While at Orlin's Vault, this mission gains the following test: [FOC] + [conflict]: Assemble the device to add 1[progress] to this mission. If your effort was 3 or more, also discard 1 error. Have 1+[per_ranger] or more [progress] on this mission: [guide] 1.116 [mountain] If you are at Orlin's Vault, add 1 error to this card unless you discard 1 AWA energy.

03367.name: To the Heart of It
03367.text:
<f>Search the arcology for information on how to relieve what is ailing its heart.</f>
Gather as much information as you can.

Return to the Cage when you feel you have sufficient information to confront and treat the arcology's heart.

B.name: Heart Attack
B.text: The only way to save the Valley from these earthquakes is to end this poor being's suffering. While at the Cage, each machine gains the following test: [FIT] + [reason]: Sabotage [2] the technology in the Cage to add 1[harm] to this machine for every 2 effort. When a machine is cleared with [harm], add 1 sabotage token to the Heart. Have 2+[per_ranger] or more sabotage tokens on the Heart: [guide] 1.125

03368.name: Contact Nal
03368.text: You received an impression in your mind from Spirit Speaker Nal. You think if you can find a quiet place to meditate and reach out to her, you might be able to more clearly communicate. You should make sure you have time left in the day before you do. [FOC] + [connection]: Meditate on your connection to Spirit Speaker Nal to move your [ranger] to this mission. Have all [ranger] on this mission: [guide] 1.118 [sun] You sense Nal's understanding. Add 1[progress] to a being.

B.name: Spirit Council
B.text: All beings except Nal gain the spirit trait. Read [guide] 1.119 instead of the normal entry for all beings and when you play a Ranger card with the Estian trait. When a being comes into play, add 1 guidance token to it. When a being is cleared, scout path cards equal to the number of guidance tokens on it. End of the Day: [guide] 1.120a You cannot travel except with 3 Estian spirits in play. When you do: [guide] 1.120 [sun] Your guides speak. Add guidance tokens to Nal equal to the number of guidance tokens on beings within reach. [mountain] If there is a being within reach, it leads the way. [right_arrow] Move that being to along the way. Double its guidance tokens.

03369.name: Overgrown
03369.text: You have found a prototype of the heart, but it has been covered in aggressive vines growing from the Verdant Sphere. Before you can examine it, you will have to clear away the overgrowth. Use [guide] 1.121 instead of the normal entry for the Verdant Sphere and for the Familiar Verdessian. [FIT] + [conflict]: Pull away the tangled overgrowth to move 1 vine from the Prototype to an active flora. Have 0 vines on the Prototype: [guide] 1.122 [sun] If a card within reach has 2 or more vines, suffer 1 fatigue.

B.name: Jury Rigged
B.text: You need to assemble components from around the arcology to engineer a defibrillation device. Choose a Ranger to put this mission in their player area. It counts as having an equip value equal to the number of checked-off bubbles. Capacative LeechSparking CircuitAny Fungus When you clear one of these cards, check off the corresponding bubble on the campaign tracker. When all three are checked off, this mission gains the following test: [FOC] + [reason]: Combine the components into a defibrillation device to read [guide] 1.123

03370.name: Cardiac Therapy
03370.text: The heart of the arcology is haunted by the trauma of the past centuries. You have to isolate and release each of its negative emotions. When an organ is cleared, the accumulated trauma is released. Flip all emotions attached to that organ facedown and attach them to this mission When 4 emotions are attached to this mission, the Heart gains the following test: [SPI] + [connection]: Revitalize [2] the spirit of the heart to read [guide] 1.126. End of the Day: [guide] 1.125a

B.name: The Cage Crumbles
B.text: The Cage is collapsing from the heart's irregular beating. Debris falls everywhere. You must act quickly before the chamber collapses! When you flip the heart, discard each fracture on this mission. For every [per_ranger] fractures discarded this way, search the General set for a Shifting Rubble and put it into play. [AWA] + [exploration]: Spot and avoid the areas where rubble is going to fall to discard fractures from this mission equal to your effort. [mountain] Add 1 fracture to this mission.

03371.name: Clear!
03371.text: Use your jury rigged defibrillator to reset the irregular beating of the arcology's heart. Have the following cards in play: - Nutrient Injector - Beat Regulator - Vagus Capacitor When all three of these cards are in play and Powered [per_ranger], the Heart gains the following test: [FIT] + [reason]: Climb [2] up to the heart and deliver the final shock to read [guide] 1.127. End of the Day: [guide] 1.125a.

B.name: The Cage Crumbles
B.text: The Cage is collapsing from the heart's irregular beating. Debris falls everywhere. You must act quickly before the chamber collapses! When you flip the heart, discard each fracture on this mission. For every [per_ranger] fractures discarded this way, search the General set for a Shifting Rubble and put it into play. [AWA] + [exploration]: Spot and avoid the areas where rubble is going to fall to discard fractures from this mission equal to your effort. [mountain] Add 1 fracture to this mission.

03372.name: Escape!
03372.text: The heart is dead. The arcology is collapsing around you. Escape to the safety of the arteries before you are buried! Severed ArteryBranching ArteryTerminal Artery End of the Day: [guide] 1.130 Arrive at one of these locations: [guide] 1.131 [sun] If there are fewer than 1[per_ranger] Shifting Rubble in play, debris falls! [right_arrow] Search the General set for Shifting Rubble and put it into play. [mountain] Add 2[harm] to an active feature or being.

B.name: Escape!
B.text: The heart is dead. The arcology is collapsing around you. Escape to the safety of the arteries before you are buried! Severed ArteryBranching ArteryTerminal Artery End of the Day: [guide] 1.130 Arrive at one of these locations: [guide] 1.131 [sun] If there are fewer than 1[per_ranger] Shifting Rubble in play, debris falls! [right_arrow] Search the General set for Shifting Rubble and put it into play. [mountain] Add 2[harm] to an active feature or being.

03373.name: The Expedition's Path
03373.text: Silaro found a logbook belonging to the lost expedition. Follow the clues in the logbook to discover the fate of each member of the expedition. Discover the fate of each member of the expedition. You can equip the Expedition Logbook reward card and read it to get clues on where to look. Return to Silaro and clear him with [progress] once this mission has 3 checkmarks.

B.name: The Expedition's Path
B.text: Silaro found a logbook belonging to the lost expedition. Follow the clues in the logbook to discover the fate of each member of the expedition. Discover the fate of each member of the expedition. You can equip the Expedition Logbook reward card and read it to get clues on where to look. Return to Silaro and clear him with [progress] once this mission has 3 checkmarks.

03374.name: One Thousand Legs
03374.text: Build a hunter's blind and lie in wait for the megapredator lurking within the arteries of the arcology. When a feature is cleared while at a location in the arcology, set it aside. These are your camouflage. When you would resolve this mission's [crest] effect, if there is 5 or more total presence of camouflage, instead: [guide] 1.133 [crest] If you are at an Artery, a massive shape zips by. [right_arrow] Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue unless you discard 1 camouflage.

B.name: Before the Mandibles
B.text: You've found the scuttlebus! Now you just need to hold on long enough to deal with it! You can add [progress] or [harm] to the attached being only while your [ranger] is on it. It gains: [FIT] + [conflict]: Jump onto the scuttlebus' slick back to move your [ranger] to this being. When the attached being is cleared, resolve the following effects instead: Clear [harm]: Permanently kill the scuttlebus [guide] 1.134 Clear [progress]: Befriend and calm the scuttlebus [guide] 1.135 [mountain] Hold on! Each Ranger whose [ranger] is on the attached being must discard 1 FOC energy or remove their [ranger].

03375.name: Mycelial Networking
03375.text: After inhaling the spores of the Ferrymen, you've begun hearing voices in the areas with higher concentrations of mushrooms. Locate a large cluster to investigate further. Have 2+[per_ranger] or more fungi in play: [guide] 1.136 [sun] Add 1[progress] to each flora within reach.

B.name: Ghost in the Mycelia
B.text: A voice, more distinct than the others, calls to you. Can you discover its source? You can Connect with flora features. Clear the flora that has the voice token with [progress]: [guide] 1.137 [sun] You may suffer 1 fatigue to keep up with the moving voice. [right_arrow] Move the voice token to another flora. [mountain] If the flora that has the voice token is ready, the voice grows distant. [right_arrow] Exhaust that flora. [crest] If the flora that has the voice token is exhausted, you lose it in the network. [right_arrow] Discard the voice token. Flip this mission.

03376.name: At the Source
03376.text: You believe the Verdessian needs your help to clear out the aggressive vines that have taken over a section of the arcology. The CisternThe Rootway Use [guide] 1.138 instead of the normal entries for these locations. Clear a Snarling Roots feature at one of these locations: [guide] 1.139 [sun] If there is no active flora, more vines creep around the corners. [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for the next flora.

B.name: Reclaimers' Fate
B.text: The Verdessian needs your help clearing out the strange, aggressive vines that have taken over a section of the arcology. The CisternThe Rootway Clear a Snarling Roots feature at one of these locations: [guide] 1.139 [sun] If there is no active flora, more vines creep around the corners. [right_arrow] Search the path deck for the next flora. [mountain] If there is a reclaimer in play, exhaust a flora. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to that reclaimer equal to that flora's presence.

03377.name: Rattling the Cage
03377.text: Whatever Silaro did at the Concordant Ziggurats has brought the arcology to life, which is causing massive earthquakes emanating from the Cage deep underground. Start of Day: Read the following entry based on the number of days since you received this mission: 3 Days: [guide] 196.1 6 Days: [guide] 196.2 9 Days: [guide] 196.3 11 Days: [guide] 196.4 12 Days: [guide] 196.5 13 Days: [guide] 196.6

B.name: The Arcology’s Secrets
B.text: With the heart at peace, you can uncover the remaining secrets of the arcology. When each of the following events is written on your campaign tracker: [guide] 1.140 - Learned of the Lost - Sampled a New Recipe - Made the Climb or Stayed Put - Tuned the Lithophone - Closed the Book - Returned to the Holt - Obeyed the Seed or Stratum 3 Lost - Reunited Quisi and Harlan - Bested Kal - Seen the Light - Comprehended the Galgothrop - Mapped the Wreckage - Braved the Dark - Made Whole the Frog - Tracked Down the Ooze

03381.name: The Valley's Splendor
03381.text: During your training, Calypsa encouraged you to pause and bask in the beauty of the Valley anytime you could find a good vantage point.
