You spot just such a view off of a spur trail ahead. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Enjoy the view from the overlook. Discard 2[per_ranger] [progress] from the location. For each [progress] discarded this way, a Ranger may soothe 1 fatigue. B) Press forward. Add [per_ranger][progress] to the location as you stick to the path. Each Ranger must either exhaust their role or suffer 2 fatigue.

03382.name: Wind and Wear
03382.text: Dirt and the elements slowly wear out all technology; even Mora Orlin's precise carbon-forged creations aren't immune to the effects of the trail. You look down and realize that some of your gear is in dire need of maintenance. YOU CHOOSE: A) Pause to perform some maintenance. [FOC] + [reason]: Repair [2] your weathered gear to add a unique token to one of your equipped tech for every 2 effort. If you fail, discard a gear from your play area or your hand. B) It'll be fine. Discard a gear from your hand or discard 3 unique tokens from among your equipped gear.

03383.name: A Cold Wind
03383.text: A biting wind pierces even the thick fabric of your cloak. It's common knowledge that no matter the season, the weather in the Valley can grow suddenly cold. You pause to consider building a small fire. If the weather is not inclement, you're thankful for the breeze. Each Ranger soothes 1 fatigue. If the weather is inclement, add 2 tokens to it, then resolve the following: RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Build a fire. Search the General set for Campfire Remains and put it into play. B) Continue undaunted. Each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue.

03384.name: Lightning Strike!
03384.text: With a sudden crack, a flash of light fills the sky. Startled, you take a breath to settle your nerves. Moments later, the sound of rolling thunder echoes in the vaulted sky. Add 3[harm] to the path card with the highest presence and 1[harm] to each card in its area. If it was within reach of a Ranger, they suffer 1 injury. If the weather is not inclement, continue reading: Lightning without a storm can only mean one thing: Electric Fog. Perform a group test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Chart [2[per_ranger]] a course away from the fog bank to discard [per_ranger] tokens from the weather. If you fail, return the current weather to the collection and put Electric Fog into play.

03385.name: A Pack Without an Owner
03385.text: You spot something out of place just off the trail: a ferroweave pack leaning up against a tree. Someone must be nearby. You wonder if perhaps you should check on them, just to make sure they're all right. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Search for the owner of the pack. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Locate [2[per_ranger]] the owner of the pack to search the Valley set for a human and shuffle them into the path deck. If you succeed by 3[per_ranger] or more, put them into play instead. Then return this card to the collection. B) No need to bother them. Search the path deck for the next human and discard them.

03386.name: A Perfect Camping Spot
03386.text: You see a wisp of smoke rising from a nearby hill. There, you find the remnants of a campfire at the center of what could only be called a perfect camping spot: a bit of shade, elevated, and secluded from view. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Take a break. Perform a group test: [SPI] + [reason]: Relax [2[per_ranger]] at the idyllic spot, then clean it up to swap rewards into your Ranger decks as if you had camped. You can displace cards from your hand, deck, or discard and add the rewards in the same location. Then, shuffle your deck. If you fail, resolve option B. B) Pass it by. Search the General set for Campfire Remains and put it into play.

03387.name: Rumbling Beneath Your Feet
03387.text:
<f>The ground beneath your feet begins to move and shift.</f>
Draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect:
[sun] <f>A sinkhole opens before you!</f> Search the Valley set for the Arcology Sinkhole and put it into play.
[mountain] Move each feature along the way to within reach of a Ranger, treating them as having Ambush.
[crest] Search the Swamp set for a Hydraworm and shuffle it into the path deck.

03388.name: A Little Lost
03388.text: It took you some time to notice, but eventually you realize that you've accidentally gone off-trail. You check your maps and scour your memory, but you are unsure which way to proceed from here. If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it to scout 2 additional cards. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Backtrack. Shuffle the path discard into the path deck. If [per_ranger] or fewer cards were added to the path deck this way, each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. B) Continue on your present course. Attach this moment to the location. Increase its presence by 1.

03389.name: Biting Flies
03389.text: You feel a surprisingly painful bite on your neck, then the back of your hand, then your face. A buzzing fills your ears as a cloud of tiny, biting flies begins to swarm you. If you see this card while scouting: Set aside all other scouted cards, resolve this card, then continue the scouting as normal. Suffer 1 fatigue, then you may perform the following test. If you choose not to, resolve its fail effect: [FIT] + [conflict]: Swat [2] the infuriating insects to discard this moment. If you fail, shuffle it into the path deck.

03390.name: Watch Your Feet
03390.text: How is it that the path can look completely clear, and yet whenever you take a moment to enjoy the view or keep an eye out for an Atrox, a big, gnarled root comes out of nowhere and catches your foot?! If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it. You may perform the following test. If you choose not to, resolve its fail effect: [AWA] + [exploration]: Regain [2] your footing before you fall on your face to add 1[progress] to the location and discard this card. If you fail, move all cards within reach to along the way and suffer 1 injury.

03391.name: Tracks in the Dirt
03391.text: You come across a set of tracks heading across the beaten path. You consider following them. It might be wise to scout the area for predators. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) See what's out there. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [reason]: Follow [1[per_ranger]] the tracks to scout 1[per_ranger] path cards. If the weather is inclement, this test's difficulty is [2[per_ranger]] instead. B) Ignore the tracks. Discard all [progress] from the being with the highest presence.

03392.name: Distant Howls
03392.text: The melodious baying of a wolhund drifts across the landscape, a reminder that predators are constantly on the prowl. You must be mindful of your actions, lest they invite the attention of a hungry being seeking its next meal. Perform a group test: [SPI] + [reason]: Reflect [2[per_ranger]] on all you've done today to have each Ranger return a card from their discard to their hand for every 2[per_ranger] effort. Then, whether you succeed or fail, each Ranger with food or tech in their Ranger discard searches the path deck and discard for the next predator and puts it into play.

03393.name: A Redolent Breeze
03393.text: The wind shifts, and the lovely scent of flowers in bloom fills the air. This particular bouquet isn't as common in this part of the Valley as it is in others. Perhaps if you followed your nose you might discover a flora rare to this region. YOU CHOOSE: A) Follow the scent. [AWA] + [exploration]: Follow [2] your nose to search a terrain set that is not currently in use for a flora and put it into play. B) Enjoy the sweet air and continue onward. Soothe fatigue equal to the total presence of all flora in play.

03394.name: Sounds from Below
03394.text:
<f>You hear a deep, resonant thrumming—distant at first, but growing louder. These sounds are somewhat common. Ben Amon believes that they originate from the ruins deep underground. Whatever their source, they begin to shake your bones.</f>
Draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect. You may draw additional challenge cards until you choose to stop.
[sun] <f>The intense vibrations cause a large pine to fall.</f> Add 1[harm] to each feature.
[mountain] <f>The unnatural thrum disturbs the wildlife.</f> Exhaust a being.
[crest] <f>The ground opens up beneath you!</f> Suffer 1 injury unless you discard 1 [AWA] energy.

03395.name: Ranger Report
03395.text: A shrill whistle reaches your ears, repeating with a familiar cadence—it is one of Mae's couriers sent out with the Ranger Report. If you can locate the source and whistle back, you can get details on the weather and other news. Perform a group test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Locate [2[per_ranger]] the source of the whistle and receive the weather forecast to either add or discard [per_ranger] tokens from the weather. If you fail, the courier warns others in the area of impending weather. Search the path deck for the next human and discard them.

03396.name: Washed Out!
03396.text: Every rainfall, the Silverfin and its tributaries swell and alter the landscape. It looks like the path ahead has been washed out by exactly such an event. A wide new meander rushes by where there used to be solid land. If you are currently using River terrain, the river picks up speed! Search the path deck and discard for the next water feature and put it into play. Otherwise: RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Ford the River. Randomly add [per_ranger] cards from the River set to the top of the path deck. B) Move to higher ground. Attach this moment to a feature in play that has a [progress] threshold. Increase its [progress] threshold by 2[per_ranger].

03397.name: Aid of the Ancestors
03397.text: Your mind drifts, and you become aware of a warm sensation in your heart. It's as though you can feel the collective energy of your ancestors, and you gain an appreciation for all that went into bringing you to this place at this exact moment. YOU CHOOSE: A) Walk fearlessly. Move your [ranger] to a feature in play. B) Be present with those around you. Attach this moment to a being. Commit 1 effort to all tests that interact with this being.

03398.name: Visions of the Past
03398.text:
<f>You sense a heaviness. A great tragedy must have transpired here long ago. It's as though you can sense the emotions of the people who were there. A vision from a thousand years past coalesces in your mind's eye. Then, suddenly, it is gone.</f>
Draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect. If you are a Spirit Speaker, you may scout 1 challenge card before drawing.
[sun] <f>The spirits show the way.</f> Add 2[progress] to the location or a feature along the way.
[mountain] <f>The vision provides insight.</f> Discard 1 [FOC] or 1 [SPI] energy to gain 1 [FIT] or 1 [AWA] energy.
[crest] <f>The vision clouds your mind.</f> Suffer 2 fatigue. Exhaust each non-machine being within reach.

03399.name: Echoes of the Invasion
03399.text:
<f>Even down here, you can see the impact of the choices made during the reclaimer invasion. You hear something echo up a nearby passageway, the telltale sound of ...</f>
If <e>RECLAIMERS WASHED AWAY</e>: <f>...rushing water.</f> Search the River set for two Strong Currents and shuffle them into the path deck.
If <e>RECLAIMERS CONSUMED</e>: <f>...Hydraworms.</f> Search the Swamp set for two Hydraworms and shuffle them into the path deck.
If <e>SPIRE FALLEN</e>: <f>...Reclaimers!</f> Search the General set for two Reclaimer Seekers and shuffle them into the path deck.

03400.name: Electrical Disruption
03400.text: A partially caved-in wall reveals a piece of damaged machinery. Electricity crackles around an intact power cell. Seems a shame to let it go to waste. It may be dangerous, but you think you might be able to remove it. YOU CHOOSE: A) Harness the machine's power. [FOC] + [reason]: Extract [2] the power cell, careful not to damage it to add 1 power or unique token to a machine or tech for every 2 effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. B) Avoid the unstable energy. Suffer 1 fatigue. Search the General set for Awakened Apparatus and put it into play.

03401.name: A Sudden Darkness
03401.text: The chamber shudders and you feel a subsonic pulse move through your body. All at once, the light sources in the environment dim to almost nothing, and the area is shrouded in darkness. Place this card in the surroundings. While this card is in play, areas cannot be illuminated. Response: At the end of the round, discard this moment. [AWA] + [reason]: Feel [2] your way through the darkness to discard this moment. If you fail, suffer 1 fatigue.

03402.name: The Passage Narrows
03402.text: Ahead, the roof of the chamber slopes downward, and the pathway narrows into a tight squeeze. You might be able to make it through, but you'll need to crawl on your belly to reach the other side. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Squeeze through. Perform a group test: [FIT] + [exploration]: Crawl [1[per_ranger]] to the other side to add 1[per_ranger] [progress] to the location. If you fail, each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue. B) Take the long way around. Discard 1[per_ranger] [progress] from among the location and features along the way.

03403.name: The Arcology Stirs
03403.text: Awakened by your approach, the area around you stirs with the thrumming of ancient machinery. Whatever purpose it may have once served is lost on you, but perhaps with time you can discern a new use for it. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Attempt to understand the perplexing machinery. Perform a group test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Discern [1[per_ranger]] how the ancient technology functions to search the Arcology set for Flowsteel Controls and put it into play. If you fail, discard 3 total unique tokens from machines and/or tech cards in play. B) Pass it by. Search the General set for Awakened Apparatus and put it into play.

03404.name: Ancient Remains
03404.text: You come across the mostly-disintegrated, skeletal remains of what must have been one of the Estians, covered in centuries of fine rock dust. You wonder what fate befell them here. YOU CHOOSE: A) Pay your respects. [SPI] + [connection]: Honor [2] the Estian's spirit to soothe 1 fatigue for every 2 effort. B) Leave them be. Discard 1 random card from your hand.

03405.name: Visitors from Above
03405.text:
<f>You feel the hint of a breeze and take a breath. The air here is fresh, though tinged with the odor of decay. You see no obvious route that leads to the surface, but you sense that there may be other visitors from above.</f>
Draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect:
[sun] Search the Ravine set for 2 Nycta Bats and a Web Wall, shuffle them into the path deck, then draw 1 path card.
[mountain] Search the Ravine set for Loose Boulders, shuffle it into the path deck, then draw 1 path card.
[crest] Search the Ravine set for a Skittish Opilion and Web Wall, shuffle them into the path deck, then draw 1 path card.

03406.name: A Sudden Crash
03406.text:
<f>A loud crash echoes from a distant chamber. What could have made such a terrible noise?</f>
<f>At the startling sound, everything around you scatters.</f> Move all beings with 2 or fewer presence along the way.
If the weather is Enveloping Silence or Reverberating Echoes, <f>the noise reverberates throughout the arcology.</f> Add 3 echoes to the weather. If it is Enveloping Silence, flip it over.

03407.name: Cave-In!
03407.text: The ceiling groans, and there is terrible rumbling all around you. You have only moments to react before the chamber collapses around you! If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it to scout 2 additional cards. Add 1[harm] to each card along the way. Then, perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Flee [2[per_ranger]] the area to add 1[progress] to the location and to each feature in play. If you fail, each Ranger suffers 1 injury unless they discard 3 cards from their hand.

03408.name: Legacy of the Ancestors
03408.text: As you traverse the subterranean remnants of the arcology, your heart grows heavy as your mind is filled with thoughts of the original inhabitants of this place. How did the Estian civilization fall to such utter ruin? EACH RANGER CHOOSES: A) Contemplate the question. Discard 2 [FOC] energy and gain 1 [SPI]. B) Pay your respects. Discard 2 [SPI] energy and gain 1 [FOC]. C) Focus on the present. Suffer 2 fatigue and gain 1 [FIT] or 1 [AWA].

03409.name: Slippery Footing
03409.text: The slick ground before you starts to slope, gradually at first, but then suddenly steep. You lose your footing, land uncomfortably on your backside, and start sliding downward! If you see this card while scouting: You can choose to discard it. You may perform the following test. If you choose not to, resolve its fail effect: [FIT] + [conflict]: Catch [2] a handhold in the rock to add 1[progress] to the location and discard this card. If you fail, move all cards within reach to along the way and suffer 1 injury.

03410.name: Glowing Gnat Cloud
03410.text: You hear a faint buzzing from up ahead, then see a tiny glowing dot. Then another. Then another. Soon, there is a cloud of the miniscule, glowing gnats swarming around your head, turning you into a beacon of light in the darkness. YOU CHOOSE: A) I'd prefer to remain in shadow. [FIT] + [conflict]: Shoo [2] the gnats away to discard this moment. If you fail, resolve option B. B) Let them be. Attach this moment to a being or feature within reach. It gains illumination. [mountain] The gnats swarm to a new target. Attach this moment to another feature or being.

03411.name: Fresh Footprints
03411.text: You come across a section of the passage that no water or weather has touched. There, you see a footprint with the distinct tread of Qory Dane, the renowned cobbler from Spire. Someone with a nice pair of boots has been through here recently. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Track the footsteps. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Follow [2[per_ranger]] the tracks of whoever's down here to search the Artery or Arcology set for a human and shuffle them into the path deck. If you succeed by 3[per_ranger] or more, put them into play instead. B) Stay on your present course. Search the Arcology set for A Shadow in the Darkness and shuffle it into the path deck.

03412.name: Thick Air
03412.text: As you reach a lower spot in the tunnel, your vision begins to blur and your head begins to throb. Silaro warned you about this — certain heavier gases can settle in tunnels and become toxic. You reflexively cover your mouth and nose. YOU CHOOSE: A) Turn back. Discard all [progress] from the location. If no [progress] is discarded, you suffer 3 fatigue. B) Continue forward, holding your breath. Add [progress] to the location equal to the number of cards in your hand, then place your hand on top of your fatigue stack.

03413.name: Campfire Remains
03413.text: Refresh: Discard 1 ember from this feature. If it has no embers on it, return it to the collection. [sun] The wind douses some of the embers. Discard 1 ember from this feature. [mountain] Add 1[harm] to a being. If this cleared that being, suffer 2 fatigue. [crest] You breathe in some of the residual smoke. Suffer 1 fatigue and discard 1 ember from this feature.

03414.name: Awakened Apparatus
03414.text: Refresh: Discard 1 power from this machine. If it has no power on it, return it to the collection. [sun] Lights flicker on above. Discard 1 power from this machine. [right_arrow] Until the end of the turn, all areas are illuminated. [mountain] Move 1 power from this machine to the machine with the least power. [crest] Structural collapse! Discard 1 power from this machine. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 fatigue.

04001.name: Silverfin Docks
04001.text: [FIT] + [reason]: Board [2] a boat along the docks to move your [ranger] to this location. Response: When you travel, if all [ranger] are on this location, you may travel by River to Spire Crossing, White Sky, or Stoneweaver Bridge (even if you do not have a vehicle). Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. [guide] 201

B.name: Silverfin Docks
B.text: [FIT] + [reason]: Board [2] a boat along the docks to move your [ranger] to this location. Response: When you travel, if all [ranger] are on this location, you may travel by River to Spire Crossing, White Sky, or Stoneweaver Bridge (even if you do not have a vehicle). Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. [guide] 201

04001.pda: Search the General set for a Backalley Shortcut and shuffle it into the path deck.

04002.name: Spire Crossing
04002.text: Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next human and put them into play. If there are no humans, search for the next being instead. [sun] If there is more than one active human, they stop to chat with one another. [right_arrow] Discard 1[progress] from each active human. [guide] 202

B.name: Spire Crossing
B.text: Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next human and put them into play. If there are no humans, search for the next being instead. [sun] If there is more than one active human, they stop to chat with one another. [right_arrow] Discard 1[progress] from each active human. [guide] 202

04002.pda: Search the General set for a Backalley Shortcut and shuffle it into the path deck.

04003.name: Brookside
04003.text: Response: After you successfully Traverse this location, scout 1 path card for every 2 effort. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 203

B.name: Brookside
B.text: Response: After you successfully Traverse this location, scout 1 path card for every 2 effort. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 203

04003.pda: Search the General set for a Backalley Shortcut and shuffle it into the path deck.

04004.name: Spire
04004.text: Any text that would affect the "Spire deck" affects the path deck instead. [AWA] + [connection]: Search the bustling town of Spire to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 5

B.name: Spire
B.text: Any text that would affect the "Spire deck" affects the path deck instead. [AWA] + [connection]: Search the bustling town of Spire to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 5

04004.pda: Search the General set for a Backalley Shortcut and shuffle it into the path deck.

04005.name: Wild Growth
04005.text: Response: After a flora enters play, add 1 pollen to it. Response: When there is 4 or more pollen on this card and/or among flora in play, move them to this card and flip it. [sun] Add 1 pollen to a flora in play. [right_arrow] Discard 1[progress] or 1[harm] from that flora.

B.name: Pollen Clouds
B.text: Response: When there is no pollen on this card, flip it. [crest] Ah-choo! Discard 1 pollen from this card. [right_arrow] Each Ranger discards 1 energy and suffers 1 fatigue.

04006.name: Crowded Thoroughfare
04006.text: Obstacle. While a Ranger is injured, this feature loses obstacle. [FIT] + [connection]: Nudge [2] your way through the crowd to exhaust this feature and add 1[progress] to it. [crest] You get lost in the crowd. This feature fatigues you.

04007.name: Busy Marketplace
04007.text: [FOC] + [connection]: Haggle [2] at the marketplace to move your [ranger] to this feature. Clear [progress]: Each Ranger whose [ranger] is on this feature may shuffle any number of cards from their hand back into their Ranger deck, then draw that many cards. [mountain] Exhaust this feature. [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for Pertinacious Peddlers and put it into play.

04008.name: Cultivated Gardens
04008.text: [AWA] + [reason]: Pick [2] fruit and vegetables from the garden to add 1[harm] to this feature and soothe 2 fatigue. [mountain] If there is an active prey or human, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to it and [harm] to this feature, both equal to that being's presence.

04009.name: Pertinacious Peddlers
04009.text: Fatiguing. Friendly. Persistent. [SPI] + [conflict]: Rebuff [2] the relentless peddlers to shuffle this being into the path deck. Clear [harm]: [guide] 214 [mountain] If there is another active human with [progress] on them, the peddlers solicit them. [right_arrow] Discard 2[progress] from that human. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04010.name: Rambunctious Teens
04010.text: Friendly. [FOC] + [connection]: Give [2] the rowdy youths something to do to move this being and exhaust them. Clear [harm]: [guide] 214 [sun] The teens stir up some trouble. You may exhaust your role. If you do not, this being fatigues you. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04011.name: Scrounging Corvids
04011.text: X is equal to the number of birds on this flock. If X is 4 or more, this flock gains obstacle and disconnected. [SPI] + [conflict]: Shoo the birds to discard 1 bird from this flock. If your effort is 3 or more, discard 2 birds instead. [sun] If there is an active human, the birds are drawn to them. [right_arrow] Add 1 bird to this flock. [mountain] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to it and [harm] to this flock, both equal to that predator's presence.

04012.name: Local Townsfolk
04012.text: Friendly. [SPI] + [exploration]: Stroll [2] with the locals to add 1[progress] to this being for every 2 effort. Then, add an equal amount of [progress] to the location. Clear [harm]: [guide] 214 [mountain] If there is another active human with [progress] on them, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] The group converses. Discard 2[progress] from both humans. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04013.name: Etra, Master of Revels
04013.text: Friendly. [FOC] + [connection]: Address [2] the gathering with Etra to add 1[progress] to this being for every 2 effort. Then, add an equal amount of [progress] to another human. Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 204 [mountain] If this test added [progress] to another human, add 1 additional [progress]. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04014.name: Festival Grounds
04014.text: [FIT] + [reason]: Help prepare the grounds to discard 1 task from this feature. Then, if there are no tasks remaining: [guide] 205.2 [sun] Add 1[progress] to each active human.

04015.name: Raemon, Caravaneer
04015.text: Friendly. [FIT] + [conflict]: Push [2] Raemon's hoversled to add 1[progress] to this being for every 2 effort. Then, add an equal amount of [progress] to a feature. Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 206 [mountain] Raemon offers to share some of his supplies. You may discard 1 supply from Raemon to gain 1 energy of any type. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04016.name: Broken Sculpture
04016.text: [AWA] + [reason]: Investigate [3] the remains of the sculpture, careful not to cut yourself, to move your [ranger] to this feature. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. Clear [ranger]: If all [ranger] are on this feature: [guide] 207 [crest] If your [ranger] is on this feature, the glass shards surround you. [right_arrow] You may exhaust your role. If you do not, suffer 1 injury.

04017.name: Bo Talos, River Trader
04017.text: Friendly. Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 208 [sun] Exhaust another active human. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04018.name: Olyv, Ranger Aspirant
04018.text: Friendly. Response: After a path card is cleared, if the location is not a ranger station, add XP to Olyv equal to the cleared card's presence. Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 209 [sun] Olyv uses her training to help you out! You may discard 1 XP from Olyv to add 1[progress] to another path card. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04019.name: Deadfall
04019.text:
During your turn, if your role is exhausted, increase this being's presence by 1.
[sun] <f>The Great Ursus lets out a terrifying roar!</f> You may exhaust your role. If you do not, suffer 1 fatigue.
[mountain] Move this being to an area that has prey. [right_arrow] Add 1[harm] to each feature in that area.
[crest] If this being is within reach, suffer 1 injury.

04020.name: Parental Bond
04020.text: Response: Before [harm] would be added to a young, if the attached being is ready, exhaust it and add that [harm] to the attached being instead. Response: After a young is cleared by [harm], its parent lashes out! Ready the attached being and each Ranger suffers 1 injury. Response: After a young is cleared by [progress], add 4[progress] to the attached being.

04021.name: Wolhund Pup
04021.text:
[sun] Ready the being with Parental Bond attached.
[mountain] If there is an active predator other than a Prowling Wolhund, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
[crest] If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

04022.name: Bearsloth Cub
04022.text:
[mountain] If there is an active predator other than a Dozing Bearsloth, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
[crest] If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

04023.name: Atrox Cub
04023.text:
[mountain] If there is an active predator other than a Pouncing Atrox, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
[crest] If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

04024.name: Scrof Shoat
04024.text:
[sun] Discard 1 token from a food you have equipped.
[mountain] If there is an active predator other than a Hungry Scrof, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
[crest] If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

04025.name: Lutrinal Pup
04025.text:
[sun] Move this being to the same area as the being with Parental Bond attached.
[mountain] If there is an active predator other than a Romping Lutrinal, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
[crest] If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

04026.name: Ursus Cub
04026.text:
[mountain] If there is an active predator other than a Wading Ursus, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
[crest] If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

04027.name: Hydraworm Spawn
04027.text:
[sun] If this being has 1 or more [harm], <f>the swamp churns.</f> [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for a Hydraworm and put it into play.
[mountain] If there is an active predator other than a Hydraworm, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
[crest] If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

04028.name: Opilion Eggs
04028.text:
[sun] If there is a Web Wall in play, discard 1[progress] from this being.
[mountain] If there is an active predator other than a Skittish Opilion, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
[crest] If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its eggs!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

04029.name: Backalley Shortcut
04029.text: While your [ranger] is on this feature, you cannot interact with humans. [AWA] + [exploration]: Discover [2] a quicker way to your destination to move your [ranger] to, or remove it from, this feature. Clear [ranger]: [guide] 212

04030.name: Cause for Celebration
04030.text: Etra Lash is planning a festival in Brookside to celebrate the sudden season of growth and renewal that has swept through the Valley. Maybe you should check it out. Brookside Arrive at Brookside: [guide] 1.222

B.name: Buzzkill
B.text: You have to find a way to get rid of this Cloudhive, or there won't be much of a festival! Response: When you travel, the day ends, or there is no mirth in play: [guide] 1.211A Use [guide] 215 instead of the normal entries for each human (if they have a [guide]). Each Cloudhive Swarm gains the predator trait and enters play with 1 additional bee on it. Cloudhive gets +2[per_ranger] [harm] and +4[per_ranger] [progress] thresholds. Refresh: Discard 1 mirth from a card. Clear Cloudhive with [harm]: [guide] 1.211B Clear Cloudhive with [progress]: [guide] 1.211C [mountain] Ready a Cloudhive or Cloudhive Swarm.

04031.name: The Festivities Begin
04031.text: Head to the Festival Grounds in Brookside to join the celebration! Brookside Path Deck Assembly: If you are arriving at Brookside, use the Thoroughfare terrain set. While Festival Grounds has no tasks remaining on it, it gains the following test: [SPI] + [exploration]: Attend [2] the festival to move your [ranger] to this feature. Have all [ranger] on Festival Grounds: [guide] 1.209

B.name: Fun and Games
B.text: Everyone has gathered together to attend the Blossom Festival. In several hours, the feast will begin. Until then, enjoy the festival with the people of Spire! Response: When you travel, flip this mission. Use [guide] 213 instead of the normal entries for each human (if they have a [guide]). [progress] cannot be added or moved to humans with mirth on them. Refresh: Add 1 time token to this mission. Add mirth to your friends by clearing them with [progress] before the feast begins. Have 3 time on this mission: [guide] 1.211 [mountain] More people arrive! Exhaust this mission. [right_arrow] Search the path deck for the next human and put them into play.

04032.name: Lost Letter
04032.text: Bo Talos has asked you to help find a letter he wrote to an old friend named Olyv Sol. The courier lost it somewhere along the way. Start of Day: If you have FOUND BO'S LETTER, flip this mission and choose a Ranger to equip it. If you BROKE THE SEAL, it enters play without its seal token. While you are at a non-pivotal location, each feature enters play with a letter token on it. Each feature with a letter on it gains the following test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Search for Bo's letter to discard a letter from this feature, add 1[progress] to it, and read one of the following entries: [guide] 1.202, [guide] 1.208, [guide] 1.212, [guide] 1.215, [guide] 1.217, [guide] 1.221, or [guide] 1.223.

B.name: Letter from Bo
B.text: Response: After you suffer an injury, discard 1 seal from this card. [guide] 1.216A [AWA] + [connection]: Peek at the letter to discard 1 seal from this card. [guide] 1.216 Have Olyv, Ranger Aspirant in play: [guide] 1.214

04033.name: Flower Collection
04033.text: Etra wants you to collect a variety of flowers to be used as decorations for the festival. Path Deck Assembly: Search the Old Growth set for 2 Cloudhive Swarms and 1 Cloudhive and shuffle them into the path deck. Sunberry BrambleTryptafoliumHanging Cherry Moss After one of these flora is cleared by [harm], check off the corresponding bubble on the campaign tracker. Return to Etra once this mission has 3 checkmarks.

B.name: Pollen Collection
B.text: Tiella wants you to collect pollen so she can determine the source of this unexpected season of rebirth. Each card with 1 or more pollen gains the following test: [FOC] + [conflict]: Collect the tiny motes of pollen to move 1 pollen from this card to the Pollen Collection mission. If your effort is 3 or more, move 2 pollen instead. Arrive at Brookside with 2+2[per_ranger] or more pollen on this mission: [guide] 1.207 [mountain] If Wild Growth is in play, a brisk wind carries the pollen away. [right_arrow] Move 1 pollen from a flora to Wild Growth.

04034.name: Supply Run
04034.text: You've agreed to meet up with Raemon and escort him back to the festival grounds with the supplies he's gathered. You'll find him at White Sky. Path Deck Assembly: Search the Old Growth set for 2 Cloudhive Swarms and 1 Cloudhive and shuffle them into the path deck. Arrive at White Sky: [guide] 1.203

B.name: Return Trip
B.text: You are escorting Raemon back to the festival grounds. Be careful not to lose any supplies! Path Deck Assembly: Search the Old Growth set for 2 Cloudhive Swarms and 1 Cloudhive and shuffle them into the path deck. Raemon, Caravaneer gains persistent. When Raemon is cleared by [harm], read [guide] 1.204 instead of his normal entry. When a feature with 1 or more supplies on it is cleared, move those supplies to Raemon. Arrive at Brookside with Raemon in play: [guide] 1.205 [sun] A box falls off the hoversled! Exhaust Raemon. [right_arrow] Move 1 supply from Raemon to the feature with the fewest supplies.

04035.name: Tracking Destruction
04035.text: Throughout the wilds, you occasionally spot evidence of Deadfall's rampage—fallen trees, trampled fields, and the like. You are sure you can locate Deadfall if you follow these signs. Path Deck Assembly: If you are arriving at a non-pivotal location, shuffle Deadfall into the path deck. Response: Before Deadfall would enter play, discard her. Then, add 1[harm] to a feature and attach this mission to that feature. When the attached feature is cleared by [progress], set it aside instead of discarding it. (Unattach this mission and return it to the surroundings.) Have 2 features set aside: [guide] 1.218 [crest] If this mission is attached, you lose the trail. [right_arrow] Unattach this mission unless a Ranger discards 1 AWA energy.

B.name: Stop the Rampage
B.text: You've found Deadfall, the Great Ursus that has been rampaging through the wilds outside Spire. Now you have to find a way to stop her! When Deadfall is cleared, resolve the following effects instead: Clear [harm]: [guide] 1.219 Clear [progress]: Deadfall cannot be cleared with [progress]. Ignore this effect. Deadfall gains the following test: [FIT] + [connection]: Remove [10] the glass shard to read [guide] 1.220. Commit 1 additional effort for every 1[per_ranger] [harm] and/or [progress] on this being. Stop Deadfall's rampage, forcibly if you must. [mountain] If Deadfall has 2[per_ranger] or more [harm], resolve her [sun] effect, then her [crest] effect.

04042.name: A Chance Encounter
04042.text:
<f>Spire is a busy place, with many travelers passing through every day. Rounding a corner, you bump into someone you know...</f>
Put a random human from the Valley set into play. Then, draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect:
[sun] <f>They look happy to see you!</f> Add 1[progress] to them.
[mountain] <f>They appear to be in the middle of a conversation.</f> Exhaust them and another human.
[crest] <f>Oh no, they look injured!</f> Add 1[harm] to them.

04043.name: Market Sale
04043.text: You spot a crowd congregating around one of Spire's open-air markets. There's a sale going on! Maybe you can take some time out of your day to browse the market and barter for something useful. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Visit the market. Each Ranger searches their Ranger deck for a gear and reveals it. Then, perform a group test: [AWA] + [reason]: Browse [2[per_ranger]] the wares on display to have each Ranger draw the card they revealed. If you fail, each Ranger discards the card they revealed. B) Move past the crowd. Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. Add 1[per_ranger][progress] to a feature.

04044.name: Tempting Melody
04044.text: The sound of a plucky mandolin catches your attention. A talespinner is joyfully playing music, and several passersby have flocked around them to listen. You wonder whether you have time to catch a song or two. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Stay awhile and listen. Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. Then, perform a group test: [SPI] + [connection]: Listen [1[per_ranger]] to the music to soothe fatigue among the Rangers equal to the group's effort. B) We'll meet again. Discard all [progress] from each human within reach of a Ranger and move each of them along the way.

04045.name: Ominous Skies
04045.text: Even among the carbon-forged buildings of Spire, the people of the village must still respect the power of nature. You watch people taking shelter as the weather worsens. If the weather is neither inclement nor hot, flip it. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Take shelter. Discard 1[per_ranger][progress] from the location as you pause to take shelter. For each [progress] discarded this way, you may add 1[progress] to a human. B) Press forward. Add 1[per_ranger][progress] to the location. Resolve each challenge effect on the weather in an order of your choice.

04046.name: Breath of the Verdessa
04046.text:
<f>A southern wind washes up the Silverfin and whistles through the buildings of Spire, bringing with it the heady scent of the Verdessa. Maybe it's your imagination, but you could swear that plants grow greener on days like these.</f>
If the weather is Wild Growth or Pollen Clouds, add 2 pollen to it.
Otherwise, return the weather to the collection and put Wild Growth into play in the surroundings with 2 pollen on it.

04047.name: Up An Alley
04047.text: From a nearby rooftop, a strange bird with colorful plumage watches you with keen interest. Oddly enough, no one else seems to notice it. It flutters off into a nearby alleyway before you can approach. If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it to scout 2 additional cards. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Follow [2[per_ranger]] the mysterious bird to search the General set for The Stranger and put it into play. If you fail, remove all [ranger] from cards in play.

04048.name: Silverfin Spillover
04048.text: You hear cries of townsfolk several buildings down and see water beginning to creep along the ground towards you. The Silverfin has a habit of spilling over its banks this time of year, and it looks to be doing so again. Perform a group test: [FIT] + [reason]: Build [2[per_ranger]] a temporary dike alongside the other residents to scout 1 path card for every 1[per_ranger] effort. If you fail, shuffle 1[per_ranger] random cards from the River set and place them on top of the path deck. Then, draw 1 path card.

04049.name: Going in Circles
04049.text:
<f>Wait... haven't you seen that building before? You're so used to navigating by the unique hills, trails, and trees of the Valley that it's difficult to find your way within all these carbon-forged structures.</f>
If there are 1 or more cards in the path discard, shuffle them and place them on top of the path deck.
If there are no cards in the path discard, shuffle this card into the top 4 cards of the path deck instead.

04050.name: Slippery Slope
04050.text: As you crest the top of a hill, you lose your footing - this side of the slope is covered in a sheet of ice! If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it. [FIT] + [reason]: Regain [2] your footing to avoid slipping and falling. If you fail, suffer 1 injury and move each card within reach to along the way.

04051.name: Weather Machinery
04051.text: What is this? A piece of machinery lies half-buried in the ground. Fog issues from a tear along its length. Perhaps if you repaired it, you could improve the weather conditions in your immediate vicinity. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Try to fix the device. Perform a group test: [FOC] + [reason]: Repair [2[per_ranger]] the machinery to either add 2 tokens to or discard 2 tokens from the weather. Then, you may flip the weather. If you fail, each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. B) Let it be. Search the Nimbus set for a Deep Fog and put it into play.

04052.name: Whispers from Afar
04052.text: The wind picks up around you, and within its howling you hear a sound halfway between a whisper and a shriek. Is it just a figment of your imagination? Or are the spirits trying to tell you something? Each Ranger reveals 1 card at random from their hand. Then... EACH RANGER CHOOSES: A) Heed the spirits. Discard the revealed card to scout Ranger cards equal to its energy cost. B) Ignore the sound. Place the revealed card on the bottom of your fatigue stack. C) Stay wary. Discard 2 [FOC] or 2 [AWA] energy to keep the revealed card in your hand. If you cannot, choose another option.

04053.name: Frigid Winds
04053.text:
<f>A sudden gust of wind carries with it the promise of snow. You wrap your cloak around your body against the bitter chill.</f>
If the weather is Blizzard, discard all snow from it as heavy winds pick up a flurry of snow.
If the weather is Pristine Snow, discard 2 snow from it and flip it as the blizzard begins to rage.
If the weather is not cold, snow starts to fall. Return the weather to the collection and replace it with Blizzard.

04054.name: A World of Gray
04054.text: What little sunlight pierced the dark gray clouds before is now blotted out by thick fog. You can barely see more than a few meters in front of you. If you see this card while scouting: Set aside all other scouted cards, resolve this card, then shuffle the set-aside scouted cards and place them back on top of the path deck. Place this card in the surroundings. While this card is in play, it gains the following text: Rangers cannot scout. [AWA] + [exploration]: Find [2] a spot of sunlight to discard this moment. (This card will be discarded along with other path cards when you travel.)

04055.name: Eyes in the Mist
04055.text:
<f>In the distance, you spot a pair of eyes glowing in the mist. A hungry predator? Or something else?</f>
Either suffer 2 fatigue, or draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect:
[sun] Search the General set for The Stranger and put it into play.
[mountain] Search the path deck and discard for the next prey and put it into play.
[crest] Search the path deck and discard for the next predator and put it into play, treating it as having ambush.

04056.name: Avalanche!
04056.text: A sudden crash sounds in the distance, followed by a thundering roar. On the horizon, a wall of snow is rapidly approaching. Perform one or both of the following group tests (Rangers choose): [FIT] + [exploration]: Dash [2[per_ranger]] out of the avalanche's path to add 2[per_ranger] [progress] to a feature. [AWA] + [exploration]: Search [2[per_ranger]] for cover to exhaust beings with up to 2[per_ranger] total presence. If you fail either test, discard all [progress] from the location and each Ranger suffers 1 injury. (Choosing not to perform one of the tests does not count as failure.)

04057.name: On Thin Ice
04057.text: As you trudge through a barren field of snow, you hear a crack and realize you are standing atop a frozen pond. You'd better watch your step, or you'll wind up in freezing-cold water! If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it. Attach this moment to your role. Response: After you Traverse, if you failed, or if your effort was 5 or more, the ice cracks! Discard this moment and suffer 3 fatigue. Response: When you travel, discard this card.

04058.name: In Digestion
04058.text: Even a single drop of the Terravore's digestive juices can spell ruin for your gear. You hear the sizzling sound of it eating through something important and immediately scramble to clean it off. Add 1 ichor to the weather. If the weather is not Acidic Ichor, flip it. You may perform the following test. If you choose not to, resolve its fail effect: [FOC] + [reason]: Mend [X] your partially digested gear to prevent it from breaking. If you fail, discard your equipped gear with the highest equip value. X is the amount of ichor on the weather.

04059.name: Intestinal Gnats
04059.text: A low droning reverberates from farther down the undulating passage. Moments later you are swarmed by a cloud of tiny insects, flitting at your face and sticking in your eyes and mouth. If you see this card while scouting: Set aside all other scouted cards, resolve this card, then continue the scouting as normal. Suffer 1 fatigue, then you may perform the following test. If you choose not to, resolve its fail effect: [FIT] + [conflict]: Swat [2] at the cloud to discard this moment. If you fail, suffer an additional fatigue and shuffle this moment into the path deck.

04060.name: Burp!
04060.text:
<f>The ground undulates and shivers beneath your feet. A sour smell fills your nostrils as the entire Terravore quakes.</f>
Draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect:
[sun] Each Ranger discards their fatigue stack.
[mountain] Add 2[harm] to each path card.
[crest] Each Ranger suffers 1 injury unless they remove their [ranger] from a path card.

04061.name: A Serendipitous Sound
04061.text: A sound that you didn't expect to hear down here greets your ears—whistling! Someone else is in here! RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Locate the whistler. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Locate [2[per_ranger]] the other person to search the Valley set for a human and shuffle them into the path deck. If the group's effort is 3[per_ranger] or more, put them into play instead. B) Leave them to face the dangers of the Terravore alone. Each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue.

04062.name: Growls from Below
04062.text: A rumbling from deep below sets your nerves on edge. Is it the Terravore itself, or the growling of some dangerous being lurking in the dark? YOU CHOOSE: A) Compose yourself. [SPI] + [conflict]: Steel [2] your resolve to add 1[progress] to the location for every 2 effort. If you fail, discard a random card from your hand. B) Voice your fears. Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue.

04063.name: Scintillating Blur
04063.text: As you trudge through the muck and mire, something colorful suddenly streaks past. You could almost swear it was a bird, but... what would a bird be doing in here? RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Follow the mysterious being. Discard all [progress] from all features in play. If at least 1[per_ranger] [progress] was discarded in this way, search the General set for The Stranger and put it into play. B) Continue onward. Add 1[per_ranger] [progress] to a feature. Then, each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue.

04064.name: Grasping Tendrils
04064.text: A slimy organ of some kind reaches out and snatches you! You struggle to break free before the Terravore's digestive ichor burns through your skin. Perform a group test: [FOC] + [conflict]: Wriggle [3[per_ranger]] free from the tendril's grasp to add 1[per_ranger] [progress] to an organ. If you fail, the active Ranger suffers 1 injury. If the group's effort is 1[per_ranger] or less, the active Ranger suffers 2 injuries instead.

04065.name: A Predictable Path
04065.text: The limited confines of the inside of the Terravore can be claustrophobic, but at least the way forward is obvious. If you can accurately predict what's ahead, your journey will be that much easier. If you see this card while scouting: Scout 2 additional cards. Perform a group test: [FOC] + [reason]: Predict [2[per_ranger]] what is coming in the constrained environment to scout 1[per_ranger] challenge cards. If you fail, shuffle the path discard into the path deck.

04066.name: Lingering Manifestation
04066.text: You hear the whistling of the wind before you feel it. Then suddenly, air rushes around you, sending your cloak flying upwards! Some strange energy is causing an inexplicable updraft in just this one spot. Each Ranger returns one of their equipped gear to their hand as the wind catches it in the updraft. If at least one of the Rangers is a Shaper, you may perform a group test: [FOC] + [conflict]: Harness [2[per_ranger]] the energy to have each Ranger equip a gear from their hand (without paying its energy cost). If the group's effort is 3[per_ranger] or more, each Shaper may return a card from their hand to the collection. Then they can choose a starting manifestation from the collection that they meet the aspect requirement for and add it to their hand. (This alteration to their deck is permanent.)

04067.name: Strange Mirage
04067.text: You stop for a moment to get your bearings, but the air shimmers and refracts in the heat, distorting the horizon. Some of the rock formations vanish and reform out of thin air, while others dance and twist in the distance. If you see this card while scouting: Set aside all other scouted cards, resolve this card, then continue the scouting as normal. YOU CHOOSE: A) Venture into the mirage. Discard 1[per_ranger][progress] from among features along the way and the location. Each Ranger gains 1 [SPI] energy. B) Wait until the mirage fades. Each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue and gains 1 [FOC] energy.

04068.name: Heat Wave
04068.text: The sun beats down on you from high above. With no shade in sight, you have no choice but to weather the oppressive heat. If the weather is hot, one at a time, each Ranger performs the following test: [FIT] + [conflict]: Endure [2] the brutal heat. If you fail, discard 1 random card from your hand and suffer 1 fatigue. If the weather is not hot, return the weather to the collection and replace it with Dry Heat.

04069.name: Dry Spell
04069.text: You take a sip from your canteen and find only a few gulps left. You'd better find some water, and soon. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Search for water. Perform a group test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Search [2[per_ranger]] for a source of potable water to have each Ranger soothe 2 fatigue. If you fail, resolve option B. B) Start rationing. Place this card in the surroundings. While this card is in play, at the start of each round, each Ranger must discard 1 energy of their choice. (This card will be discarded along with other path cards when you travel.)

04070.name: Yowtch!
04070.text:
<f>From out of nowhere, a sharp pain jolts your ankle. You limp away, only to see that you...</f>
Draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect:
[sun] <f>...rolled your ankle on uneven ground!</f> Search the Valley set for an Arcology Sinkhole. It fatigues you.
[mountain] <f>...were stung by a cactus spine!</f> Search the Mesa set for an Opuntia Patch.
[crest] <f>...were bitten by a snake!</f> Search the Mesa set for a Slithering Rattler.

04071.name: Fight or Flight
04071.text: You watch as a hierax dives from high above in pursuit of a mysterious bird with long, vivid tailfeathers. If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it to scout 2 additional cards. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Defend the mysterious bird. Perform a group test: [SPI] + [conflict]: Chase [2[per_ranger]] the hierax away to search the General set for The Stranger. If you fail, each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue. B) Let it be. The hierax perches nearby. Search the Mesa set for a Soaring Hierax.

04072.name: Tremor
04072.text: All of a sudden, the earth begins to shake! What disturbance below the surface could be causing this tremor? You should find an open area, away from any falling rocks. Each Ranger removes their [ranger] from a path card or the location. Each Ranger who cannot suffers 2 fatigue. You may perform the following group test: [FIT] + [reason]: Keep [1[per_ranger]] your footing amidst the quakes to have a Ranger move their [ranger] to a feature for every 1[per_ranger] effort.

04073.name: Spark of Inspiration
04073.text: The rhythm of the trail, whether challenging or steady, gives you time to think. Sometimes it's meditative, other times, inspiration strikes! Perform a group test: [FOC] + [reason]: Capture [2[per_ranger]] the inspiring moment to have each Ranger search their Ranger deck for a card and add it to their hand. If you fail, each Ranger shuffles a card from their hand into their fatigue stack as the thought slips away.

04074.name: The Stranger
04074.text: Clear [progress] or [harm]: Return this being to the collection. [sun] Move this being. If it is within reach of a Ranger, that Ranger soothes 1 fatigue. [mountain] Add 1[progress] to the location and to this being. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to that predator and to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04075.name: Terra Lodge
04075.text: Effigies attached to Terra Lodge are not considered to be path cards, and lose all of their traits, types, text, and challenge effects. Response: Once per day, when you travel, each Ranger chooses and shuffles 1 card from their discard pile into their deck for each effigy attached to this location. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 226

B.name: Terra Lodge
B.text: Effigies attached to Terra Lodge are not considered to be path cards, and lose all of their traits, types, text, and challenge effects. Response: Once per day, when you travel, each Ranger chooses and shuffles 1 card from their discard pile into their deck for each effigy attached to this location. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 226

04075.pda: Search the Terra Lodge set for each non-human being and attach them faceup to this location as effigies.

04076.name: The Otherwoods
04076.text: [FOC] + [reason]: Peer through the veil between worlds to scout cards from the top of the Otherworld deck equal to your effort. Then if your [ranger] is on Shimmering Eaves, you may draw the top card of the Otherworld deck. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 227

B.name: The Otherwoods
B.text: [FOC] + [reason]: Peer through the veil between worlds to scout cards from the top of the Otherworld deck equal to your effort. Then if your [ranger] is on Shimmering Eaves, you may draw the top card of the Otherworld deck. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 227

04076.pda: Do not add Transdimensional Rift and Entity from Afar to the path deck. Shuffle them together with 6 random cards from the Ravine set and 6 random cards from the Swamp set (other than Heart of the Swamp), then set them next to the path deck. This is the Otherworld deck.

04077.name: Crystal Basin
04077.text: [SPI] + [reason]: Drink from the purified waters to add 1[progress] to this location for every 2 effort. Then soothe an equal amount of fatigue. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 228

B.name: Crystal Basin
B.text: [SPI] + [reason]: Drink from the purified waters to add 1[progress] to this location for every 2 effort. Then soothe an equal amount of fatigue. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [guide] 228

04078.name: Sentinel Peak
04078.text: Refresh: Discard 1 oxygen from this location. Then, if there is no oxygen on this location, each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue. Response: After [progress] is added to this location, if its [progress] threshold is reached, you may search the General set for Snow-Capped Summit and put it into play. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. [guide] 229

B.name: Sentinel Peak
B.text: Refresh: Discard 1 oxygen from this location. Then, if there is no oxygen on this location, each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue. Response: After [progress] is added to this location, if its [progress] threshold is reached, you may search the General set for Snow-Capped Summit and put it into play. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. [guide] 229

04078.pda: Search the Nimbus set for an Icy Path and 3 Deep Fogs, and add them to the path deck.

04079.name: Arbor Mists
04079.text: Each Deep Fog enters play along the way instead of within reach. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next mist feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next mist feature and put it into play. [guide] 230

B.name: Arbor Mists
B.text: Each Deep Fog enters play along the way instead of within reach. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next mist feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next mist feature and put it into play. [guide] 230

04079.pda: Add 3 random cards from the Woods set to the path deck.

04080.name: The Undergrove
04080.text: [FOC] + [exploration]: Cross [4] the precarious catwalks to move your [ranger] to this location. Increase the difficulty by 1 for each Deep Fog in play. You may discard up to 3[progress] from this location to commit an equal amount of effort. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [crest] If you failed this test, the fog obscures the maze of catwalks. [right_arrow] Move your [ranger] from this location to a Deep Fog in play. [guide] 231

B.name: The Undergrove
B.text: [FOC] + [exploration]: Cross [4] the precarious catwalks to move your [ranger] to this location. Increase the difficulty by 1 for each Deep Fog in play. You may discard up to 3[progress] from this location to commit an equal amount of effort. Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [crest] If you failed this test, the fog obscures the maze of catwalks. [right_arrow] Move your [ranger] from this location to a Deep Fog in play. [guide] 231

04081.name: Nimbus Facility
04081.text: Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [mountain] Add 1 power to this location. Then if there is 4 or more power on this location, flip the weather and discard all power from this location. [guide] 232

B.name: Nimbus Facility
B.text: Arrival Setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. [mountain] Add 1 power to this location. Then if there is 4 or more power on this location, flip the weather and discard all power from this location. [guide] 232

04082.name: Cloudstrider
04082.text: Response: When this being enters play, each Ranger moves their [ranger] to the Deep Fog with the fewest [ranger] on it. [mountain] If there is an active Deep Fog, move it along the way. [crest] If your [ranger] is on a Deep Fog or Icy Path, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

04083.name: Snowtrodding Hare
04083.text: [FIT] + [conflict]: Follow [2] the elusive hare to add 1[progress] to this being for every 2 effort. Then you may move your [ranger] to a feature or to your role. [mountain] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04084.name: Haze Lilacs
04084.text: [SPI] + [reason]: Crush [2] the lilacs and take in their invigorating fume to add 1[harm] to this feature, soothe 1 fatigue, and gain 1 energy of any type. Clear [harm]: Search the path deck and discard for a Deep Fog and put it into play. [sun] If there is [harm] on this feature, mist erupts from the broken branches. [right_arrow] Move your [ranger] to an active Deep Fog. [mountain] If there is an active prey, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to it and [harm] to this feature, both equal to that prey's presence.

04085.name: Saber-toothed Leopard
04085.text:
While there is a Deep Fog in play, this being gains ambush.
[mountain] <f>The leopard chases you into the fog.</f> Move your [ranger] to an active Deep Fog.
[crest] If you have 3 or more fatigue, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

04086.name: Icy Path
04086.text: Dangerous. [FOC] + [exploration]: Tread [2] carefully over the ice to move your [ranger] to this feature. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. [crest] If your [ranger] is on this feature, you start to slip. [right_arrow] Return your [ranger] to your role unless you spend 1 FIT.

04087.name: Deep Fog
04087.text: Untraversable. [AWA] + [exploration]: Navigate through the fog to add [progress] to this feature equal to your effort. If you fail, move your [ranger] to this feature. [crest] If your [ranger] is on this feature, it fatigues you.

04088.name: Cloud Generator
04088.text: [FOC] + [reason]: Operate [2] the esoteric device to exhaust this feature and each Deep Fog in play. [sun] Exhaust this feature. [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for a Deep Fog and put it into play.

04089.name: Viv Terra, Lodge Keeper
04089.text: Friendly. [FOC] + [connection]: Call [3] forth the spirits of the wild to return a card from your hand to your collection to choose a starting spirit from your collection that you meet the aspect requirement for and add it to your hand. (This alteration to your deck is permanent.) Clear [harm] or [progress]: [guide] 233 [crest] If there are 2 or more active predators, exhaust 1 of them. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04090.name: Oz Terra, Novice Hunter
04090.text: Friendly. [SPI] + [conflict]: Regale Oz with tales of the hunt to exhaust an effigy attached to the location. If you do, add [progress] to this being equal to your effort plus the exhausted effigy's presence. Clear [harm] or [progress]: [guide] 234 [mountain] If there is an active predator, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Exhaust that predator. [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04091.name: Glade of Effigies
04091.text: [SPI] + [reason]: Record [2] an epic confrontation in the form of effigy to read [guide] 235.1. [sun] You may exhaust an effigy attached to the location. If you do, soothe 1 fatigue.

04092.name: Transdimensional Rift
04092.text: Response: After a challenge card without [shuffle] resolves during a test other than the ones on this feature, attach it facedown to this feature, to a maximum of 5 attached cards. [FOC] + [reason]: Study the rift to look at a number of random facedown cards attached to this feature equal to your effort and discard any number of them. [SPI] + [conflict]: Venture [2] into the rift to read [guide] 236.4. Perform this test only if there are 2 or more challenge cards attached to this feature.

04093.name: Entity from Afar
04093.text: Fatiguing. Clear [progress]: [guide] 237 [sun] If there is an odd number of [progress] on this being, it vanishes. [right_arrow] Shuffle it into the Otherworld deck.

04094.name: Shimmering Eaves
04094.text: [SPI] + [conflict]: Venture [2] into the eerie woods to move your [ranger] to this feature. If you fail, suffer 1 fatigue. Response: When you would draw a path card, if your [ranger] is on this feature and there are cards remaining in the Otherworld deck, draw a card from the Otherworld deck instead.

04095.name: Storm Regulator
04095.text: X is the amount of power on this feature. Response: After the weather flips, add 1 power to this feature. [FOC] + [reason]: Manipulate [5] the device's controls to either discard 1 power from this feature or exhaust a snow, funnel, mist, or electricity feature. Commit X additional effort to this test.

04096.name: Observation Deck
04096.text: [SPI] + [exploration]: Marvel at the bird's-eye view of the Valley to, once per day, soothe fatigue equal to your effort. Clear [progress]: [guide] 240.1

04097.name: Nimbus Spirit
04097.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit. [FOC] + [exploration]: Observe the weather patterns to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then scout 1 path card. [sun] You may exhaust this spirit and discard 3[progress] from him to add 1 token to or discard 1 token from the weather.

04098.name: Prismatic Elk
04098.text: [FOC] + [connection]: Comprehend [3] the nature of the entity to move your [ranger] to this being. Response: After you interact with this being, either move it or it fatigues you. [mountain] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add 3[harm] to that predator and [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence. [crest] If this being has any [harm] on it, or if your [ranger] is on it, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

04099.name: Remi Byrd, Hermit
04099.text: Friendly. [SPI] + [reason]: Cooperate with Remi to perform another test after this one. Commit additional effort to that test equal to your effort on this test. Clear [harm] or [progress]: [guide] 243 [crest] If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

04100.name: Snow-Capped Summit
04100.text: [FOC] + [reason]: Study [2] the clouds nearby to, once per day, add 2 tokens to or discard 2 tokens from the weather. Clear [progress]: If all [ranger] are on a Spiderline Stanchion and you FIRED A NEW LINE, read [guide] 244.1.

04101.name: Remi's Treehouse
04101.text: While your [ranger] is on this feature, reduce any fatigue you suffer by 1, and you cannot traverse. [FIT] + [reason]: Climb in or out of the treehouse to move your [ranger] to, or remove it from, this feature. Response: When the travel phase begins, if all [ranger] are on this feature, you may spend a comfortable night in Remi's treehouse. Read [guide] 245.1. (This will end the day.)

04102.name: Snowdrift
04102.text:
Obstacle.
You can add a maximum of 2[progress] per test to this feature.
[sun] Exhaust one of your equipped gear.
[mountain] Exhaust a companion within reach.

04103.name: Pristine Snow
04103.text: Path Deck Assembly: Search the General set for a Snowdrift and shuffle it into the path deck. Refresh: Discard 2 snow from this card. If there is no snow remaining, flip this card. [sun] Soothe 1 fatigue.

B.name: Blizzard
B.text: [FIT] + [reason]: Shelter [2] from the storm to add 1 snow to this card for every 2 effort. If there is 4 or more snow, flip this card. [sun] Add 1 snow to this card. [right_arrow] Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. Then if there is 4 or more snow, flip this card. [mountain] Discard 1[progress] from a card along the way.

04104.name: Storm Brewing
04104.text: An unnatural storm has appeared over the northern reaches of the Valley. With each passing day, it seems to grow larger and larger. Based on the number of days since you received this mission, the following locations have localized weather (Pristine Snow): 0+ Days: Sentinel Peak, The Undergrove, Arbor Mists, Nimbus Facility 2+ Days: Also; Crystal Basin, Terra Lodge, The Otherwoods 4+ Days: Also; Atrox Mountain, Northern Outpost 6+ Days: Also; Lone Tree Station, Golden Shore, Mount Nim, White Sky Start of Day: If it has been 10 days since you received this mission, read [guide] 246.2.

B.name: Storm Brewing
B.text: An unnatural storm has appeared over the northern reaches of the Valley. With each passing day, it seems to grow larger and larger. Based on the number of days since you received this mission, the following locations have localized weather (Pristine Snow): 0+ Days: Sentinel Peak, The Undergrove, Arbor Mists, Nimbus Facility 2+ Days: Also; Crystal Basin, Terra Lodge, The Otherwoods 4+ Days: Also; Atrox Mountain, Northern Outpost 6+ Days: Also; Lone Tree Station, Golden Shore, Mount Nim, White Sky Start of Day: If it has been 10 days since you received this mission, read [guide] 246.2.

04105.name: To the Summit
04105.text: In order to learn more about the blizzard affecting the northern reaches, you must first investigate the mysterious stormcloud hanging still in the sky. The best place to do so would be the summit of Sentinel Peak, the mountain far to the north. Sentinel Peak Have Snow-Capped Summit in play: [guide] 1.227

B.name: On the Line
B.text: In order to reach the structure floating within the storm, you must fire a new spiderline from the nearby stanchion. While you are at Sentinel Peak, Spiderline Stanchion gains the following tests. Each test other than the first can only be performed once a Ranger has succeeded at the test above it. [FIT] + [reason]: Climb [1[per_ranger]] to the top of the stanchion. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. [AWA] + [connection]: Spot [1[per_ranger]] a landmark on which to latch a new line. Perform this test only if there are no non-friendly beings within reach. [SPI] + [exploration]: Visualize [1[per_ranger]] hitting your target. Perform this test only if you have 5 or more cards in hand. [FOC] + [conflict]: Fire [1[per_ranger]] the new spiderline to read [guide] 1.228a. Perform this test only if the weather is not inclement. Reach the floating island.

04106.name: Beyond the Mist
04106.text: Search through the fog to discover the true purpose of this strange place. The UndergroveArbor MistsNimbus Facility Response: When you clear a Deep Fog while you are at one of the above locations, draw a challenge card and resolve the effect corresponding to its challenge icon: [sun]: Scout 2 path cards. [mountain]: Move your [ranger] to another Deep Fog in play. [crest]: Shuffle this Deep Fog into the path deck instead of discarding it. While at one of the above locations, have 2 or more Deep Fogs in the path discard: [guide] 1.229

B.name: Beyond the Mist
B.text: Search through the fog to discover the true purpose of this strange place. The UndergroveArbor MistsNimbus Facility Response: When you clear a Deep Fog while you are at one of the above locations, draw a challenge card and resolve the effect corresponding to its challenge icon: [sun]: Scout 2 path cards. [mountain]: Move your [ranger] to another Deep Fog in play. [crest]: Shuffle this Deep Fog into the path deck instead of discarding it. While at one of the above locations, have 2 or more Deep Fogs in the path discard: [guide] 1.229

04107.name: Ghost of a Chance
04107.text: Conditions around the facility are worsening by the hour. Your only hope is to somehow learn how to shut it down from the station's keeper. You've seen his spirit roaming through the Arbor Mists. Perhaps if you commune with him... Nimbus Spirit cannot be cleared. While Nimbus Spirit has [progress] equal to or greater than his threshold, he gains the following test: [SPI] + [conflict]: Expand [5] your consciousness to move your [ranger] to this spirit. Commit additional effort to this test equal to the number of tokens on the weather. Have all [ranger] on Nimbus Spirit: [guide] 1.230 [mountain] If your [ranger] is on Nimbus Spirit, move it to an active Deep Fog.

B.name: Silence the Storm
B.text: If left unchecked, this storm will never cease. Your only hope is to shut down the station's primary storm regulator at the Nimbus Facility. Path Deck Assembly: If your current terrain is Nimbus, add Ball Lightning and Cerberusian Cyclone to the path deck. Response: After a snow, funnel, mist, or electricity feature leaves play, add 1 power to Storm Regulator. Have no power on Storm Regulator: Sever the current. [guide] 1.231A Have 6+[per_ranger] power on Storm Regulator: Overcharge the machinery. [guide] 1.231B [sun] If there are no active snow, funnel, mist, or electricity features, search the path deck for the next one and put it into play. [crest] If Storm Regulator has 5 or more power, it overloads! [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury unless you spend 1 AWA.

04108.name: The Other Side
04108.text: Deep in the Otherwoods, you found another yeti. It seems to need your help tracking down the Tenebrae for some inscrutable purpose. Path Deck Assembly: If you are not arriving at The Otherwoods, search the Valley set for The Tenebrae and shuffle it into the path deck. If The Tenebrae is in play and is the only path card in its area, it gains the following test: [FOC] + [reason]: Deploy [2] the device the yeti gave you to read [guide] 1.236. [mountain] Move The Tenebrae to the area with the most path cards. [crest] If The Tenebrae is active, it fatigues you unless you spend 1 SPI. If it is inactive, suffer 1 fatigue from its haunting sound.

B.name: Crossing Over
B.text: With the Tenebrae in tow, you must make your way back to the heart of the Otherwoods. The Tenebrae gains persistent. If The Tenebrae and Transdimensional Rift are both in play, this mission gains: Refresh: Look at 3 random challenge cards attached to Transdimensional Rift. If all 3 have the same challenge icon, read [guide] 1.237. Help the yeti by bringing The Tenebrae back to the rift in The Otherwoods. [mountain] Move The Tenebrae to the area with Transdimensional Rift.

04109.name: True Colors
04109.text: Viv Terra has informed you of a ghostly elk she's seen in the woods, composed entirely of scintillating light. She's tasked you with tracking it down and discovering its true nature. Shimmers are features with 0 presence and the following test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Follow [2] the trail left by the elk to set this shimmer aside. Have 2[per_ranger] or more shimmers set aside: [guide] 1.232 [sun] If you are at a non-pivotal location, place the top card of your Ranger deck facedown within reach, as a shimmer. [crest] For each shimmer within reach, either draw it into your hand or suffer 1 fatigue.

B.name: Battle of Wills
B.text: You've tracked down the elk. Now it's up to you to unveil the truth of this strange entity. When Prismatic Elk would be cleared by [ranger], resolve the following effect: Clear [ranger]: [guide] 1.233 [harm] or [progress] cannot be added or moved to Prismatic Elk unless all [ranger] are on it. While all [ranger] are on Prismatic Elk, it gains the following thresholds and clear effects: 4[per_ranger] harm, 6[per_ranger] progress. Clear [harm]: Quell the entity [guide] 1.234 Clear [progress]: Help it come to terms with its existence [guide] 1.235 [sun] If your [ranger] is on Prismatic Elk, return it to your role unless you spend 1 AWA.

04111.name: Climbing Harness
04111.text: [FIT] + [exploration] (use 1 piton): Climb the terrain to choose an ascent. Then choose options equal to your effort (you may choose an option multiple times): Add 2[progress] to that ascent. Exhaust that ascent if it is a feature. Move your [ranger] to that ascent.

04113.name: Nimbus Spirit
04113.text: Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit. [FOC] + [exploration]: Observe the weather patterns to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then scout 1 path card. [sun] You may exhaust this spirit and discard 3[progress] from him to add 1 token to or discard 1 token from the weather.

04114.name: Aspect of the Elk
04114.text: Attach to a spirit or companion. Exhaust: Ready the attached being or add 2[progress] to it.

04115.name: Extraspatial Veil
04115.text: Response: After the weather flips, add 1 shift to this gear. Use 1 shift: Before a challenge effect on the weather would resolve, cancel that effect.

04201.name: Adaptive Glass Shard
04201.text: Exhaust: Add 2 [harm] to a feature or being and 1 crack to this gear. Exhaust: When you would suffer an injury, add 2 cracks to this gear instead. Response: After 1 or more cracks are added to this gear, discard cards from the top of the challenge deck equal to the number of cracks on this gear. If 2 or more [crest] symbols are discarded, the glass explodes into thousands of pieces. Suffer 1 injury, return this gear to the collection, and remove a checkmark next to Adaptive Glass Shard on your campaign tracker.

04202.name: True Friendship
04202.text: If there is a human in play, add 3 [progress] to that human or add 3 [progress] to the location. If Helping Hand is attached to that human, do both instead.

04203.name: Floral Cloak
04203.text: Response: When you pertorm a test, if your [ranger] is on a flora, you may dodge each card in the same area as that flora. [AWA] + [exploration]: Blend into the environment to move your [ranger] to a flora.

04204.name: Growth Serum
04204.text: Exhaust (use 1 spray): Discard 1 [harm] from a flora and either exhaust it or resolve its [mountain] effect.

04205.name: Rousing Speech
04205.text: Each Ranger may spend any amount of energy of one aspect to gain that much energy of another aspect.
